AL.com - Secretary of State Wes Allen says Alabama’s new absentee voting law in effect for November election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=090324_3&amount=25]
There's no way to sugarcoat this, Team: Alabama recently made it harder to vote by mail.
Alabama lawmakers recently passed SB1, a bill that opponents of voting rights said would stop so-called "ballot harvesting", which is what they call it when pro-voting organizations assist in the "distribution and collection of absentee ballot applications". In short, Alabama is criminalizing activists who go door to door and help people apply to vote by mail.
It's worth noting that high-priority bills are given the lowest numbers. A bill like this being given number 1 should tell you everything about the importance they put on voter suppression.
Even after pro-voting advocates highlighted how it would keep elderly and disabled voters from getting the help they need with mail-in voting and pointed to the lack of examples of ballot harvesting cases in Alabama as evidence that the law was not needed, Alabama's vote-suppressing Secretary of State is rushing to implement the new law.
Voter suppression like this anywhere hurts us everywhere, Team. My work documenting the sordid mess of [politics in Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/1e257ec0-bbbf-40dc-a771-8ad35537e79b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) often drives me towards nihilism. Most recently, the [theatrical](https://substack.com/redirect/cacf7673-1bff-410b-b6a7-c9a1f5940360?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Democratic National Convention and [continuing farce](https://substack.com/redirect/be683392-a17d-4eb2-8110-0d256e0e5c47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the 2024 election left me gnashing my teeth, so I'm grateful to have enjoyed the chance to escape for a week and indulge my various inner children at a countercultural training academy in the Nevada desert.
My first year attending Burning man was in 2003, just after finishing law school. I'd heard amazing things about the gathering, and fell into a phenomenal camp when slipping inside an opening door on a street in San Francisco that led me up a set of stairs--and into the arms of one of the most loving communities I'd ever encountered to that point in my life.
Many participants fetishize Burning Man, treating it as the centerpiece of their social lives even in the depths of winter. Others belittle it, reducing it to yet another music festival despite its many unique elements. I ultimately see it as a gateway to a broader set of elusive, inspiring, and (both personally and socially) transformative countercultures.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/837cccf8-e590-4a13-b2e4-e8feeb5eaa1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Thursday morning, after my friend Sarah painted my face and Laurita braided my beard and stitched a pendant into it
I'll start with the 10 official principles adopted by the community. Over the course of the next week or so, I'll also share a few examples of them from this year and others before it.
### **10 principles**
On the one hand, the countercultures that converge at Burning Man reflect a dramatically broad swath of the world. Yet, despite coming from one side of the planet to the other, and embracing musical tastes and cultures wildly different from one another, burners find commonality in a series of [profoundly important principles](https://substack.com/redirect/fef0ff6b-7695-4562-8d53-25dd05d60623?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As explained at [BurningMan.org](https://substack.com/redirect/e52001e2-bdf0-4b9f-b293-a123813402b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), they include:
1. **Radical Inclusion** : Anyone may be a part of Burning Man. We welcome and respect the stranger. No prerequisites exist for participation in our community.
2. **Gifting** : Burning Man is devoted to acts of gift giving. The value of a gift is unconditional. Gifting does not contemplate a return or an exchange for something of equal value.
3. **Decommodification** : In order to preserve the spirit of gifting, our community seeks to create social environments that are unmediated by commercial sponsorships, transactions, or advertising. We stand ready to protect our culture from such exploitation. We resist the substitution of consumption for participatory experience.
4. **Radical Self-reliance** : Burning Man encourages the individual to discover, exercise and rely on their inner resources.
5. **Radical Self-expression** : Radical self-expression arises from the unique gifts of the individual. No one other than the individual or a collaborating group can determine its content. It is offered as a gift to others. In this spirit, the giver should respect the rights and liberties of the recipient.
6. **Communal Effort** : Our community values creative cooperation and collaboration. We strive to produce, promote and protect social networks, public spaces, works of art, and methods of communication that support such interaction.
7. **Civic Responsibility** : We value civil society. Community members who organize events should assume responsibility for public welfare and endeavor to communicate civic responsibilities to participants. They must also assume responsibility for conducting events in accordance with local, state and federal laws.
8. **Leaving No Trace** : Our community respects the environment. We are committed to leaving no physical trace of our activities wherever we gather. We clean up after ourselves and endeavor, whenever possible, to leave such places in a better state than when we found them.
9. **Participation** : Our community is committed to a radically participatory ethic. We believe that transformative change, whether in the individual or in society, can occur only through the medium of deeply personal participation. We achieve being through doing. Everyone is invited to work. Everyone is invited to play. We make the world real through actions that open the heart.
10. **Immediacy** : Immediate experience is, in many ways, the most important touchstone of value in our culture. We seek to overcome barriers that stand between us and a recognition of our inner selves, the reality of those around us, participation in society, and contact with a natural world exceeding human powers. No idea can substitute for this experience.

[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=148470363&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4NDcwMzYzLCJpYXQiOjE3MjU0MDk0MTIsImV4cCI6MTcyODAwMTQxMiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.662gBHMy4l4jmYv9ac6uATV7mTtplM4yGy_SFMZlCZg)
Some of these principles can stand in tension with others. For instance, communal effort can become a crutch inhibiting radical self-reliance, just as easily as it can be a liberating factor enabling it.
Similarly, decommodification can create challenges for the vision of leaving no trace. Last year, the Burning Man organization sparked some controversy by [shutting down camps that offered bicycles](https://substack.com/redirect/e73bbf52-10b7-48cb-b066-ca1ca5a88432?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) available to be picked up and dropped off at the event. While motivated by the goal of reducing commodification (in the form of paid services and bike rentals), the policy predictably increased the number of bicycles left behind after the event.
Gifting and civic responsibility are two other principles from the event that have inspired me for years. I envision dedicating another post to them soon.
### **Participation: A lesson in subjectivity**
When I first came to the playa in 2003, I enjoyed the great fortune of being part of Sol System, a theme camp that held down the 2:00 corner at Esplanade that year and the following year (when I skipped Burning Man to instead [support protests](https://substack.com/redirect/ce43ce0f-aeba-4616-97d8-15807413f207?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the Republican National Convention in NYC).
Sol System was a formidable camp composed of hundreds of participants from around the country. We built a groundbreaking sound system arrayed in a Stonehenge pattern that created a sweet spot in the middle unlike anything over ever heard since. Other camp members built a statue, and I joined the build crew for the first iteration of [an evolving art installation](https://substack.com/redirect/e653b800-2290-4a05-9475-7c95d0425e28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that, over the past 20 years, has been installed all over the world, from China to the city hall of a major California city.
Even though 2003 was my first year either on the playa or camping with that group, many people I met at camp thought I had played a leadership role and approached me as a resource because they saw me MC a fundraising auction that we had organized a few weeks before coming to the desert.
Each time I explained that I was a newbie in this community, folks reacted with surprise. I realized, meanwhile, that I myself maintained an impression that everyone else spent considerable time together back in the city, when the reality was that they lived across many communities and were grateful for the chance to converge from their various lives.
In short, everyone looked on everyone else as if they were closer to the center, while each observer internalized an impression of standing on the social periphery. To me, it was a license to suspend my self-impression and step into the center--not only of Sol System, but also other communities I would come to encounter in the years since then.

### **Finding mirrors in companions**
Like many people among my friends, I struggle to see myself. Even though gratitude is a conscious practice of mine and I find many reasons to give thanks every day, the uniqueness of my perspective, my path, and my characteristics often fades in the face of whatever challenge or frustration bedevils me on any given day.
Routines seem to make that problem worse. I appreciate them as much as anyone, while recognizing that they can suppress the wonder and awe that my gratitude cultivates.
It feels obvious to me that the greatest resources we each encounter in this life are other people. In the desert, many participants gravitate towards the formidable, expansive, and visionary installation art built by artists from around the world. Others relentlessly pursue the musicians who most inspire them, excited by the opportunities to see so many in one place and also to share social space with them.
The part of the event that has most inspired me, however, is the crowd. Burning Man is unique among gatherings in that the events, shows, performances, and workshops are curated, organized, and executed not by a production company hiring professionals, but rather the participants.
Among other things, one thing that means is that there are more works of art, more parties, and more potential soulmates than one could possibly discover in a mere week. But we do our best nonetheless!
Some of the inspiring figures who I met in the desert last week include:
* a Mexican-American college history professor who advised a major brand on how to incorporate empathy into its customer service platform before marrying a colleague with whom he made treats for the camp including ice cream, caprese salad, and grilled cheese sandwiches.
* a forensic chemist who works with law enforcement on screening suspicious materials for radioactivity and toxicity, and worked with me on cooking a meal for our camp drawn from one of my mother's recipes.
* a grad student and athlete exploring the psychology & brain chemistry enabling human vision who came to the playa for the first time, handled the experience like a seasoned pro, and taught me that one need not necessarily enjoy any given musical experience in order to dance like you do.
* a filmmaker (with whom I used to camp & party a decade ago on the east coast!) who just finished [a phenomenal documentary](https://substack.com/redirect/628b8910-b6b9-40e8-b409-54ef8d0106e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about indigenous rights and deforestation in the Amazon, and abducted me for a 48-hour escapade that entailed shredding dance floors from one side of the city to the other.
* a traveler and athlete who I first encountered in Havana, Cuba in 2014, where she helped me pick out a wooden sculpture that sits on my dresser to this day. We'd crossed paths only once since then during a surprise weekend in San Francisco, which later left me wondering whether she was real or instead a figment of my imagination.
* not one--but several--young Filipino American DJs whose inner children are so present that gratitude moved them to tears at the seeming drop of a hat. I watched a group of grown-ass straight men hold each other and cry into each other's arms after getting lost in a dust storm and then finding each other at camp.
* a pair of mothers in their 60s whose kids brought each of them to the desert. I found them chatting during one of our parties before we discovered connections: one's daughter (who will come up again in a moment) led the camp in which I camped this year, and the other's sons camped with me ten years ago!
* an ex-boyfriend of my latest ex-girlfriend who came to feel like a brother from another mother, and whose performances in the desert may have led him to professional opportunities beyond his wildest dreams
* a co-worker, friend, and neighbor who has incessantly inspired me since the day I first crossed her path. I knew that she was coming to the gathering, but wasn't sure I'd see her until she magically appeared next to me (on my way home from visiting my friend from Havana, no less). We shared several adventures over the course of the week that I'll have a hard time forgetting, including dancing in shadow boxes that enlarged our silhouettes before a crowded dance floor moving to the music of a mutual DJ friend (who started our camp, and whose mom came up a few paragraphs ago).
* [DJ Shango](https://substack.com/redirect/eca78c2b-3587-4b28-93be-1611f0273e25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a tribal house DJ from Philadelphia with whom I used to play parties in the early 2010s when I lived in DC. We found each other dancing at a mid-week party (with the best dancers I saw all week) celebrating "[A Seat on the Throne](https://substack.com/redirect/ebbad22c-c6bc-4bb9-bb27-97f8366ec117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," a powerful afro-futurist sculpture by artist [Chelsea Odufu](https://substack.com/redirect/5549157f-f0cf-49b3-8c80-0cc37553b4ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Brooklyn. Then Shango & I kept seeing each other on random dance floors over the rest of the week, which is rather remarkable in the midst of a community of 55,000 people.
* several family members related to a billionaire who I've publicly criticized. I shared a long evening with them, watching the Man burn from the second floor of an art car while listening to an impressive pianist & vocalist (who later recognized me and shared some powerful words of encouragement) playing songs including covers of Elton John and Stevie Wonder hits. I briefly tended bar and played a short DJ set before introducing them to [the Sonic Runway](https://substack.com/redirect/e653b800-2290-4a05-9475-7c95d0425e28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (where we danced to an art car playing songs inspired by the Grateful Dead), and later attending their cousin's wedding.
* a DJ couple at my camp who drove me to tears twice: once, when the guy in the couple shared with me that he voted for me in 2020, and felt that the character assassination that drove me from San Francisco was a blessing since it ultimately "brought you to us"; and again the next morning when his wife offered a card reading that felt like an entire season of therapy sessions. The images below summarize it. My favorite aspect was the closing recommendation embodied by both her & her husband.

I still share it from time-to-time, especially for burners exploring the playa for the first time. It encapsulates my guidance for newbies and explains what I consider "the point" of the experience that we all share together..._

Burning man offers a lot more than the world's most spectacular party | | | Sep 4| | | ∙| | Preview ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | My work documenting the sordid mess of often drives me towards nihilism. Most recently, the Democratic National Convention and of the 2024 election left me gnashing my teeth, so I'm grateful to have enjoyed the chance to escape for a week and indulge my various inner children at a countercultural training academy in the Nevada desert. My first year attending Burning man was in 2003, just after finishing law school. I'd heard amazing things about the gathering, and fell into a phenomenal camp when slipping inside an opening door on a street in San Francisco that led me up a set of stairs--and into the arms of one of the most loving communities I'd ever encountered to that point in my life. Many participants fetishize Burning Man, treating it as the centerpiece of their social lives even in the depths of winter. Others belittle it, reducing it to yet another music festival despite its many unique elements. I ultimately see it as a gateway to a broader set of elusive, inspiring, and (both personally and socially) transformative countercultures. | | ---|---|--- Thursday morning, after my friend Sarah painted my face and Laurita braided my beard and stitched a pendant into it I'll start with the 10 official principles adopted by the community. Over the course of the next week or so, I'll also share a few examples of them from this year and others before it. 10 principles On the one hand, the countercultures that converge at Burning Man reflect a dramatically broad swath of the world. Yet, despite coming from one side of the planet to the other, and embracing musical tastes and cultures wildly different from one another, burners find commonality in a series of . As explained at , they include: 1. Radical Inclusion : Anyone may be a part of Burning Man. We welcome and respect the stranger. No prerequisites exist for participation in our community. 2. Gifting : Burning Man is devoted to acts of gift giving. The value of a gift is unconditional. Gifting does not contemplate a return or an exchange for something of equal value. 3. Decommodification : In order to preserve the spirit of gifting, our community seeks to create social environments that are unmediated by commercial sponsorships, transactions, or advertising. We stand ready to protect our culture from such exploitation. We resist the substitution of consumption for participatory experience. 4. Radical Self-reliance : Burning Man encourages the individual to discover, exercise and rely on their inner resources. 5. Radical Self-expression : Radical self-expression arises from the unique gifts of the individual. No one other than the individual or a collaborating group can determine its content. It is offered as a gift to others. In this spirit, the giver should respect the rights and liberties of the recipient. 6. Communal Effort : Our community values creative cooperation and collaboration. We strive to produce, promote and protect social networks, public spaces, works of art, and methods of communication that support such interaction. 7. Civic Responsibility : We value civil society. Community members who organize events should assume responsibility for public welfare and endeavor to communicate civic responsibilities to participants. They must also assume responsibility for conducting events in accordance with local, state and federal laws. 8. Leaving No Trace : Our community respects the environment. We are committed to leaving no physical trace of our activities wherever we gather. We clean up after ourselves and endeavor, whenever possible, to leave such places in a better state than when we found them. 9. Participation : Our community is committed to a radically participatory ethic. We believe that transformative change, whether in the individual or in society, can occur only through the medium of deeply personal participation. We achieve being through doing. Everyone is invited to work. Everyone is invited to play. We make the world real through actions that open the heart. 10. Immediacy : Immediate experience is, in many ways, the most important touchstone of value in our culture. We seek to overcome barriers that stand between us and a recognition of our inner selves, the reality of those around us, participation in society, and contact with a natural world exceeding human powers. No idea can substitute for this experience. Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! This post is public, so feel free to share it. Some of these principles can stand in tension with others. For instance, communal effort can become a crutch inhibiting radical self-reliance, just as easily as it can be a liberating factor enabling it. Similarly, decommodification can create challenges for the vision of leaving no trace. Last year, the Burning Man organization sparked some controversy by available to be picked up and dropped off at the event. While motivated by the goal of reducing commodification (in the form of paid services and bike rentals), the policy predictably increased the number of bicycles left behind after the event. Gifting and civic responsibility are two other principles from the event that have inspired me for years. I envision dedicating another post to them soon. Participation: A lesson in subjectivity When I first came to the playa in 2003, I enjoyed the great fortune of being part of Sol System, a theme camp that held down the 2:00 corner at Esplanade that year and the following year (when I skipped Burning Man to instead at the Republican National Convention in NYC). Sol System was a formidable camp composed of hundreds of participants from around the country. We built a groundbreaking sound system arrayed in a Stonehenge pattern that created a sweet spot in the middle unlike anything over ever heard since. Other camp members built a statue, and I joined the build crew for the first iteration of that, over the past 20 years, has been installed all over the world, from China to the city hall of a major California city. Even though 2003 was my first year either on the playa or camping with that group, many people I met at camp thought I had played a leadership role and approached me as a resource because they saw me MC a fundraising auction that we had organized a few weeks before coming to the desert. Each time I explained that I was a newbie in this community, folks reacted with surprise. I realized, meanwhile, that I myself maintained an impression that everyone else spent considerable time together back in the city, when the reality was that they lived across many communities and were grateful for the chance to converge from their various lives. In short, everyone looked on everyone else as if they were closer to the center, while each observer internalized an impression of standing on the social periphery. To me, it was a license to suspend my self-impression and step into the center--not only of Sol System, but also other communities I would come to encounter in the years since then. Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers.To receive new posts, sign up for a free subscription! To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber. Finding mirrors in companions Like many people among my friends, I struggle to see myself. Even though gratitude is a conscious practice of mine and I find many reasons to give thanks every day, the uniqueness of my perspective, my path, and my characteristics often fades in the face of whatever challenge or frustration bedevils me on any given day. Routines seem to make that problem worse. I appreciate them as much as anyone, while recognizing that they can suppress the wonder and awe that my gratitude cultivates. It feels obvious to me that the greatest resources we each encounter in this life are other people. In the desert, many participants gravitate towards the formidable, expansive, and visionary installation art built by artists from around the world. Others relentlessly pursue the musicians who most inspire them, excited by the opportunities to see so many in one place and also to share social space with them. The part of the event that has most inspired me, however, is the crowd. Burning Man is unique among gatherings in that the events, shows, performances, and workshops are curated, organized, and executed not by a production company hiring professionals, but rather the participants. Among other things, one thing that means is that there are more works of art, more parties, and more potential soulmates than one could possibly discover in a mere week. But we do our best nonetheless! Some of the inspiring figures who I met in the desert last week include: a Mexican-American college history professor who advised a major brand on how to incorporate empathy into its customer service platform before marrying a colleague with whom he made treats for the camp including ice cream, caprese salad, and grilled cheese sandwiches. a forensic chemist who works with law enforcement on screening suspicious materials for radioactivity and toxicity, and worked with me on cooking a meal for our camp drawn from one of my mother's recipes. a grad student and athlete exploring the psychology & brain chemistry enabling human vision who came to the playa for the first time, handled the experience like a seasoned pro, and taught me that one need not necessarily enjoy any given musical experience in order to dance like you do. a filmmaker (with whom I used to camp & party a decade ago on the east coast!) who just finished about indigenous rights and deforestation in the Amazon, and abducted me for a 48-hour escapade that entailed shredding dance floors from one side of the city to the other. a traveler and athlete who I first encountered in Havana, Cuba in 2014, where she helped me pick out a wooden sculpture that sits on my dresser to this day. We'd crossed paths only once since then during a surprise weekend in San Francisco, which later left me wondering whether she was real or instead a figment of my imagination. not one--but several--young Filipino American DJs whose inner children are so present that gratitude moved them to tears at the seeming drop of a hat. I watched a group of grown-ass straight men hold each other and cry into each other's arms after getting lost in a dust storm and then finding each other at camp. a pair of mothers in their 60s whose kids brought each of them to the desert. I found them chatting during one of our parties before we discovered connections: one's daughter (who will come up again in a moment) led the camp in which I camped this year, and the other's sons camped with me ten years ago! an ex-boyfriend of my latest ex-girlfriend who came to feel like a brother from another mother, and whose performances in the desert may have led him to professional opportunities beyond his wildest dreams a co-worker, friend, and neighbor who has incessantly inspired me since the day I first crossed her path. I knew that she was coming to the gathering, but wasn't sure I'd see her until she magically appeared next to me (on my way home from visiting my friend from Havana, no less). We shared several adventures over the course of the week that I'll have a hard time forgetting, including dancing in shadow boxes that enlarged our silhouettes before a crowded dance floor moving to the music of a mutual DJ friend (who started our camp, and whose mom came up a few paragraphs ago). , a tribal house DJ from Philadelphia with whom I used to play parties in the early 2010s when I lived in DC. We found each other dancing at a mid-week party (with the best dancers I saw all week) celebrating "," a powerful afro-futurist sculpture by artist from Brooklyn. Then Shango & I kept seeing each other on random dance floors over the rest of the week, which is rather remarkable in the midst of a community of 55,000 people. several family members related to a billionaire who I've publicly criticized. I shared a long evening with them, watching the Man burn from the second floor of an art car while listening to an impressive pianist & vocalist (who later recognized me and shared some powerful words of encouragement) playing songs including covers of Elton John and Stevie Wonder hits. I briefly tended bar and played a short DJ set before introducing them to (where we danced to an art car playing songs inspired by the Grateful Dead), and later attending their cousin's wedding. a DJ couple at my camp who drove me to tears twice: once, when the guy in the couple shared with me that he voted for me in 2020, and felt that the character assassination that drove me from San Francisco was a blessing since it ultimately "brought you to us"; and again the next morning when his wife offered a card reading that felt like an entire season of therapy sessions. The images below summarize it. My favorite aspect was the closing recommendation embodied by both her & her husband. | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Paid subscribers can access a poem that I wrote many years ago for a performance at Opulent Temple before a few thousand burners. I still share it from time-to-time, especially for burners exploring the playa for the first time. It encapsulates my guidance for newbies and explains what I consider "the point" of the experience that we all share together... Unlock this post for free, courtesy of Shahid Buttar. subject: AIPAC is extremist, not moderate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, some will
have you believe that AIPAC, the anti-Palestinian lobby group funded by
Republican megadonors and corporate special interests, is moderate.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240903.r7gDMW&refcode=em20240903-35962&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35962%2E1203867%2ETxglMc ]Tweet from Beth Miller: It is obscene to call a group that spend $100m
to scare electeds into supporting military funding for a foreign
government that is slaughtering and starving Palestinians “moderate.”
AIPAC’s policies are extremist and their tactics are build around fear.
[screenshot of headline: AIPAC emerges as moderate force in political
primaries]

Make no mistake: AIPAC threatens the foundation of our democracy by buying
elections and using its war chest to scare elected officials into giving
unconditional support to Israel’s genocidal, right-wing government.

AIPAC may have won in New York and St Louis this summer by spending over
$25 million in the most expensive congressional primaries in history, but
that doesn’t mean they’re winning. With your support, we’re giving them a
run for their money, forcing them to spend more than ever before to win
races and push for policies that the majority of voters reject.

By not backing down from AIPAC, our progressive bloc in Congress is not
only fighting for human rights for all people but fighting back against
fascism and the corporate takeover of our democracy. Our mandate is clear:
we must get big money out of politics. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240903.r7gDMW&refcode=em20240903-35962&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35962%2E1203867%2ETxglMc ]If you agree, support Justice
Democrats’ work to do just that with a grassroots donation of
$5 today →

When our Party discusses fascism, we often focus on Donald Trump — and
while he is a major threat to our democracy, solely focusing on Trump
ignores the systemic issues we face, like our broken campaign finance
system that enables AIPAC to wield such power and influence.

This fight is bigger than AIPAC: the lobby group has created a blueprint
for right-wing Super PACs to try buying elections and put forth a playbook
that is now being replicated by other corporate and wealthy interests,
like the cryptocurrency and Big Tech industries. It’s beyond time for the
Democratic Party to get serious about campaign finance reform and take big
money out of politics once and for all.

Primary battles like Jamaal Bowman’s and Cori Bush’s are an assault on our
democracy, and no Super PAC—no matter the issue or ideology—should be
allowed to spend this much money in our elections. Now is the time we put
people back at the center of our democracy, and democracy back at the
center of our Party.

Every single one of our progressive priorities faces the same obstacle: a
broken campaign finance system that allows corporations and special
interest groups to control our Democratic agenda with their wallets. If we
want an end to the genocide in Palestine, Medicare for All, and a Green
New Deal, then we have to end a system that prioritizes the needs of
corporate defense contractors, Big Pharma and health insurance companies,
and Big Oil and the fossil fuel industry over the priorities of everyday
people.

The Joe Manchin’s and Kyrsten Sinema’s of the world don’t obstruct labor
law legislation or climate change policies for themselves, but on behalf
of their biggest corporate benefactors who have bought that influence in
Congress.

Many of the same donors who are spending against progressives like Cori
and Jamaal are threatening Kamala Harris to back their corporate policies,
or else.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240903.r7gDMW&refcode=em20240903-35962&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=35962%2E1203867%2ETxglMc ]The entire Democratic Party must fight back against these interests if
we want to have a reflective, social democracy that centers people, not
corporate interests. If you’re with us, fuel the fight ahead by pitching
in whatever you can afford now.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240903.r7gDMW&refcode=em20240903-35962&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=35962%2E1203867%2ETxglMc ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240903-35962-footer&t=1024&refcode2=35962_1203867_TxglMc&akid=35962%2E1203867%2ETxglMc

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: imagine this . . .
body:
You’re going to want to take a look at these...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Just imagine PRESIDENT Kamala Harris cackling for her pals in the press as she signs national abortion legislation into law that:

• Eradicates any and all life-saving laws for babies across the country;
• Forces abortion up until birth on all 50 states; and
• Forces taxpayers like you and me to pay for it all.
If the Abortion Lobby gets its way in November, that nightmare scenario I just told you about could very well come true as early as January.

That’s why, with Labor Day now behind us – _the traditional start of all campaigns' mad dashes to the finish_ – I’m counting on your IMMEDIATE action and generosity before it’s too late.

You see, we’re now just two weeks from the start of early voting in many states!

So, we have to act now.

The good news is, _Students for Life Action_ is ready to start deploying activists and start door-knocking in key Battleground and Referendum States!

I’ll share with you __what__ exactly these programs entail and __where__ our students will be deployed shortly, **[but first can I count on you to make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ right away to bolster our Election Year Efforts](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giltril-duchtdja-y/)?**

**Here’s the deal, Pro-Life Friend . . .**

The Abortion Lobby is practically already popping the champagne corks, believing nothing can stop them from installing Kamala Harris in the Oval Office, seizing back control of the U.S. House, and holding onto a slim Senate Majority.

Should they succeed, there could be no stopping their radical agenda, including:

*****_PACKING THE U.S. SUPREME COURT_** with as many as five new justices who will serve as rubber stamps for _Planned Parenthood’s_ radical and bloody agenda;

*****_DESTROYING THE U.S. SENATE FILIBUSTER_ ,** which is a Senate rule that effectively requires all major legislation to gain 60 Senate votes for passage; and

*****_RAMMING PRO-ABORTION LEGISLATION FAR WORSE THAN _ROE V. WADE_ INTO LAW_,** that would force all 50 states to allow abortion-on-demand up until _(and even up to a week after)_ birth – _and force taxpayers to fund it all!_
_So, if we don’t fight back NOW, we could be toast._

That’s why, right now, _Students for Life Action_ is recruiting hundreds of young, enthusiastic pro-life student activists to participate in our **2024 Election Year Programs** and then deploying them in the following towns/states:

• Bozeman, Montana: _September 7-8 th_
• Sioux Falls, South Dakota: _September 7-8 th_
• Kearney, Nebraska: _September 21-22 nd_
• Phoenix, Arizona: _October 5-6 th_
• Tucson, Arizona: _October 5-6 th_
• Wayne, Michigan: _October 5-6 th_
• Rochester, New Hampshire: _October 12-13 th_
• Elizabeth City, North Carolina: _October 12-13 th_
• Concord, North Carolina: _October 12-13 th_
• Celebration, Florida:_October 19-20 th_
• St. Charles, Missouri: _October 19-20 th_
• Oklahoma City, Oklahoma: _October 26-27 th_
• (CITY TBD), Pennsylvania: _November 2-3 rd_
These deployments are so critical, you and I can’t afford to miss out on even a SINGLE ONE.

_That is, unless we want to watch a Harris-Walz Presidency snuff out the lives of countless little preborn boys and girls for the next four years . . ._

But of course, I’m counting on you to please keep these deployments rolling before these dates get too close, and it’s too late.

**[So, will you please consider making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s_ 2024 Election Year Programs so we can run them at full steam ahead as we head into the final stretch of election season](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giltril-duchtdja-j/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, here’s the crux of everything I’ve shared with you so far . . .

Through these deployments, if we can educate pro-life voters regarding the records of legislators and candidates on protecting the preborn this spring, we’ll have a greater chance to pass and enact strong pro-life legislation in 2025, which will save thousands of babies from abortion.

Our involvement will also have national impact by finally DESTROYING this false narrative that being pro-life is a political liability!

With that goal in mind, _Students for Life Action_ is mobilizing the Pro-Life Generation by:

**• _CONDUCTING GRASSROOTS TRAININGS_ –** where we train new young activists so they can start making an impact, effectively knock on doors, make phone calls, and stay in the fight for years to come;

**• _RAMPING UP DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING_ –** where our students will personally knock on hundreds of thousands of doors and even collaborate with homeschool groups and church communities to expand our reach;

**• _HOLDING EARLY VOTER AND VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS_ –** where we target ideal voter bases like mega-churches, church conferences, and Christian college campuses to beat the Left to the punch on early voting;

**• _EXPANDING OUR ON-CAMPUS OUTREACH_ –** where we’ll host campus voter rallies and educational displays, recruit volunteers, organize door-to-door canvassing deployments, and even bus pro-life voters to the polls who don’t have a ride; and

**• _RUNNING NON-STOP PHONE BANKS AND TEXTING PROGRAMS_ –** where we’ll conduct peer-to-peer text messaging and phone calls which are a must in any effective Get-Out-The-Vote programs.
## **[>> DONATE TO _STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION’S_ ELECTION YEAR PROGRAMS <<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giltril-duchtdja-t/)**
Pro-Life Friend, we have the plans, we have the means, and we have the manpower . . .

Now I just need the resources.

**[So, please make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s_ 2024 Election Year Programs as we head into crunch time](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giltril-duchtdja-i/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – If you’d like to chip in another way and join our student activists for one or more of our deployments, you can do so by clicking **[HERE](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giltril-duchtdja-d/)!**

_Students for Life Action’s_ staff will be present at each event, and we will cover your logistics like meals and transportation!

Of course, if you can’t join any of our deployments, **[you can still always help our efforts by chipping in a generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ in any amount](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giltril-duchtdja-h/).**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.
---
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you are no longer interested you can [unsubscribe instantly](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-u-giltril-duchtdja-l/).

body:
| Team,

At his absolutely ridiculous, rambling Mar-a-Lago press conference last month, Donald Trump made a whole host of outrageous comments and claims.

This one didn’t make a huge splash amidst the other insane things he said, but it stood out to me: _**"If anybody I know is Jewish and they would vote for Kamala over me, they should have their heads examined."** _ Well, I am Jewish. And I am proudly going to cast my vote for Vice President Kamala Harris. But I certainly don’t want my head examined by Donald Trump.

I’m proud of my Jewish faith, friend. From a young age, Judaism has guided my values. Especially the teaching of Tikkun Olam, or repairing the world.

Over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix.

But Tikkun Olam guides me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.

That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

This one didn’t make a huge splash amidst the other insane things he said, but it stood out to me: "If anybody I know is Jewish and they would vote for Kamala over me, they should have their heads examined." Well, I am Jewish. And I am proudly going to cast my vote for Vice President Kamala Harris. But I certainly don’t want my head examined by Donald Trump. I’m proud of my Jewish faith, friend. From a young age, Judaism has guided my values. Especially the teaching of Tikkun Olam, or repairing the world. Over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. But Tikkun Olam guides me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours. That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. name: Jerry Evans
subject: I Can’t Sleep
body:
| | |
---
|
---
| Friend,
I'm sorry for emailing you this late, but I just couldn't sleep. I'm awake because I'm worried about our future, as many of us are. I'm concerned about the spillover of crime from what is going on in Chicago, about the sluggish economy, falling wages and increasing prices of goods. Millions of people pouring through the Southern border unvetted and a real possibility of a foreign conflict escalating into war. There is a better way.
That's why I'm running for the U.S. Congress, because we need new leadership in Washington. Leadership that is willing to engage with the community and understands the concerns of folks who are also up late, worried about the future of their families, community and America as a whole.
When I get to Congress, I will put an end to the inflation by fighting against the over-spending in Washington, cutting regulations for small business owners and working across the aisle to solve the border crisis, the rising cost of energy, goods and housing, so that everyone has a chance at the American Dream.
My opponent doesn't understand what it is like to worry about a mortgage payment, and that's why he won't debate, discuss substantive policy or show up to many community events even after more than a decade in office!
---
|
---
| I'm a small business owner, an educator and a father. I know this community and the challenges we are facing both locally and nationally. I have no plans to spend a decade or more in congress, because that is not my goal. My goal is to solve the issues we all face, and come home to a better and more prosperous community.
If you share my concerns about our future, please consider [chipping in $5, $10 or $25](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KgnhoC4SvKGf6dvGg_2r8e50vr_2d_bQHmXCf5Gc403f9KhrMcvD9pZ0Lm0C6pDYLLygY9QWxm02aAKyyKhm0pbLvApk7DiOviAYCnlR3MSK3L_ayBaVd4fMNN2YSFoE-pXLI5B-T4tL7sYYThfDrnANVbh0MGaw-pThpJHfF8f_210--YIG-3hnvnVo-OyXLXQgRElVX3s=&c=gCMaBB2By97rgbQywav_gduFtIsUiXHAw7amQKyQm6rHMbOGJZeI6Q==&ch=4Ke_rPsKLGMmH-BZC-Xtnsn-0LMFOfXgRgLTW1ZJQ2eT1_0wbhJdxQ==) and spreading the word about this campaign to your friends! Together, we will work to find common ground so that our future is always better than our past.
Goodnight,
Jerry Evans

subject: 2024 September e-newsletter

| | | |

| | |
# 2024 September e-newsletter
---
|
---
|
---
| **Sutter Health reopens Mickelson Warm Water Therapy Pool**
---
| Dear friends, A little more than two years ago on a hot Saturday morning in downtown San Mateo, the streets along El Camino Real were filled with the sound of music as the Raging Grannies led a chorus of a song a member wrote called “Bring back the Mickelson Pool” at a rally of about 100 supporters I held in partnership with Lindsay Raike, the founder of a nonprofit called Warm Water Wellness. We held the rally to urge Sutter Health officials to reopen the Mickelson Arthritis and Rehabilitation Center on the Mills Health Center campus that was closed due to Covid in March 2020 and which Sutter announced would permanently close June 24, 2021.
---
Today, I am extremely proud to announce that Sutter officially reopened the Mickelson pool in San Mateo Tuesday, Aug. 20 after spending $1 million this year to rehabilitate the facility. It took an incredible grassroots effort and a paradigm shift in thinking at Sutter to reopen the pool and I’m incredibly grateful to see all of the community’s efforts pay off. I want to especially thank Lindsay’s years of persistence to get us to this point. I also want to thank Warner Thomas, who assumed the reigns of CEO of Sutter Health Corporate in Sacramento in November 2022 and Darian Harris, who became CEO of the Mills-Peninsula Medical Center in Burlingame and San Mateo in July 2023 for realizing the value the pool has in San Mateo County.
---
| **County contributes $14 million for Midway Village** The largest affordable housing project in San Mateo County’s history received key financial support from the Board of Supervisors at its August 27 meeting. By a unanimous vote, supervisors approved a $14 million that will spur the construction of Phase 2 at Midway Village, located near the Cow Palace in Daly City’s Bayshore neighborhood. This is probably, in terms of housing in San Mateo County, one of the most transformative projects ever with 555 units of housing for foster youth, seniors, veterans and families. The County, through the Housing Authority, is working with partners to transform and expand Midway Village into a neighborhood that showcases affordable housing in the modern age. The new housing will also help achieve functional zero homelessness. On-site amenities will include childcare, a community garden, an exercise room, meeting space and outdoor recreation areas. Residents will include former foster youth, who will be offered an array of supportive services, as well as individuals and families and people who formerly experiences homelessness. Led by nonprofit housing developer MidPen Housing, construction of Phase 1 was completed in May 2024, providing 147 units of affordable housing, and a parking garage that will serve residents of both Phase 1 and Phase 2. Former Midway Village residents are given priority for the new housing. The latest loan approval will kickstart development of Phase 2, which includes a total of 111 units ranging from studios to four bedrooms along with two additional units for on-site managers.
---
---
|

**Groundbreaking for new North County Wellness Center**

I was honored to break the ground Thursday Aug. 29 on the new North County Wellness Center — a game-changer for health care access.

This $133 million state-of-the-art clinic will offer primary care, specialty services, optometry and dental care, adding 10,000 patient visits a year for those most in need. This is a huge win for residents in north San Mateo County who often cannot get doctor’s appointments at smaller county clinics for several months. I’m proud to have served with Supervisor Dave Pine on the subcommittee that brought this project to life.

When it opens in 2026, the center’s clinics at 1094 Mission Road in South San Francisco will primarily serve individuals and families who receive care through Medi-Cal or are eligible for Medi-Cal, which provides free or low-cost programs.

In addition to services provided by County Health and the Human Services Agency, the three-story, 77,000-square-foot building will also provide satellite offices for the District Attorney and Treasurer/Tax Collector.

The Wellness Center’s design – described by the architect as contemporary and contextual – uses an abundance of natural wood instead of synthetic materials commonly found in paneling and ceiling tiles. The timber also softens the visual impact compared to most alternatives and naturally helps to muffle the sounds of a busy office. I can’t wait to welcome the clinics first patients when it opens.
---
|

**Restauranteur slashes prices to help seniors and youth connect**

I was delighted to join Elio D’Urzo, the owner of Ristorante Sapore Italiano in downtown Burlingame, to announce a concept to help often isolated and lonely seniors connect with youth as they gather for a family-style buffet lunch and share stories in a small-town Italian setting.

D’Urzo charged only $9.99 Monday through Friday from noon to 2 p.m. (the buffet menu generally starts at $32) starting August 15 to mark the beginning of Ferragosto, a two-week summer vacation period in Italy. He told me he plans to continue this concept perhaps into the winter.

For the cost of a hamburger from a fast-food joint, Elio is creating an atmosphere where seniors, high school kids and others can make meaningful intergenerational connections as they share an incredible meal in a small-town Italian setting.

Elio understands that connecting younger and older people not only combats social isolation but also improves mental and physical well-being. If you’ve never been to Sapore, I can tell you it has become the piazza on Burlingame Avenue where you will hear lively conversations in both Italian and English and feel like you are among family.”

Learn more about Sapore here: [https://www.saporeitalianoristorante.com/about-us](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=4fbafbb07f&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **
Furry friends a remedy for loneliness**

Thank you to all who joined and participated in a special event my office hosted in partnership with the Peninsula Humane Society to highlight how pets have been proven to ease loneliness, reduce stress, anxiety and depression and improves your mental and physical health. The event launched the first in my office’s “Loneliness to Light Series” that will continue into the coming months.

Having a furry friend may be the best prescription a doctor can give if you are isolated and battling loneliness. Daily walks with your dog lowers obesity rates and increases the likelihood of making meaningful connections with other people, connections that may have been lost during the pandemic.

Special thanks to Dr. Gretchen Reevy, a renowned researcher at Cal State East Bay, and Dr. Lynette Hart from UC Davis, who shared their insights on how pets can be a remedy for loneliness and improve overall well-being.

Some of you may remember in January, San Mateo County was the first in the United States to declare loneliness a public health crisis, a resolution sponsored by my office. I look forward to continuing the very important work of raising awareness on the epidemic of loneliness and how to address it.

Read an article in the Mercury News about the event:[ https://www.mercurynews.com/2024/07/26/san-mateo-county-fight-loneliness-with-furry-friends/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=9ae6674779&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=0e7b8bc52b&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [tbayudan@smcgov.org](mailto:tbayudan@smcgov.org) .
---
| **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=b842afc811&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e191771be0&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=73d88c62f4&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 In friendship,
David J. Canepa

name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA
subject: The next generation needs this
body:
We’re in a moment of national reflection.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zt2vivh9qfgsimh2nf9nmjl5pjsd1o6scn5ugn10_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gm2o36c1h2bs)
---
Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z8maekcbp911p6o4bg5398quuamvacnpaabptb70_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gm2o36c1h2bs)_
---
[**Make your gift & get your FREE book**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zgcibma2av6h7hn5h19vjgrvuf35h398i5495928_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gm2o36c1h2bs)
---
Friend, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znf0n9vashs0j7ma80kucg1hvd0u0sp2ckcvuleg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gm2o36c1h2bs)**_
---

---

| Hello Fellow Patriot,

Our nation is at a crossroads, facing immense challenges that threaten our values and the future we hope to build. Conservative principles like faith, liberty, community, and life are under constant attack. It's in times like these that we look to leaders who embody these values. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4qs2nfat75sh3jq9ot1jelrbpjpk7pq5jo0jve8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gm2o36cth2bs) Dr. Ben Carson has dedicated his life to these principles, serving as an accomplished neurosurgeon, a Presidential cabinet member, and a steadfast champion of conservative values. But today, Dr. Carson finds himself needing your support in a deeply personal way.

**As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Will you take a moment to[sign his birthday card](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuq9n8ucls88qh513ji7e42qfuktl61gu0abipvo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gm2o36cth2bs) and add a personal note?**

Thousands of individuals who cherish the same values have already signed the card, showing that Dr. Carson is not alone in this fight. But it will take a groundswell of support to make our collective voices heard and to show that we stand united behind leaders like Dr. Carson.

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zslrkusdnjp7b4j03dpoc2o0a01qn4mb2h99hckg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gm2o36cth2bs)

After signing, you'll have the opportunity to further support the American Cornerstone Institute and the principles Dr. Carson represents. Your help is crucial in restoring faith, bringing patriotic education back to our schools, and healing the divisiveness that holds us back from real progress.

Thank you for your support, and may God bless you.

The American Cornerstone Institute

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4s0ivti92u87sdeckolfll9tkudqei8824m4peo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gmao75c5h2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7l6j8a8jcej60d4bm3enijfusv4384mvm8m8fjo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gmao75c5h2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7hicnc3mfss4f118np7lk5qt34ibj1cptcigrl8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gmao75c5h2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---

American Briefing
---

| | Dear Concerned American,

Our progressive elites have found a backdoor for their radical agendas when they are defeated at the ballot box. They can pressure businesses to go woke!

We exist to shine a light on the crazy excesses of the woke ideology invading businesses across America and then to fight back for you.

Did you know ... Gatorade is pushing men in women's sports by providing "Equity in Sports" resources?

These resources include reports and guidelines for schools, coaches. and sports leagues on how to get more biological males competing against young girls in sports.

We can't sit idly by. We invite you to participate in our Survey on Woke Companies, where you can share your views on what businesses should prioritize and who they should serve.

Your input will help us shout louder and land more rhetorical haymakers that embarrass woke companies and CEOs into retreat.

Let's tell corporate America:
* Woke agendas won't work!

Let voters make policy through the voting booth and consumers make decisions with their pocket books instead of elites dictating woke ideology from BlackRock's boardrooms in NYC.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Brand-new prophecy resources
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8aih6b8vlm1ouvppv4cgavt67rpbahc8gsfo0c8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gmeor4c3h2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z836olgiglmi3ievelo3g5tsrj7m58jo57pe0om0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gmeor4c3h2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1qob84jg07bqd3mmkub2dtsl9l1umpcsmcu8588_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c5gmeor4c3h2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

subject: This isn't over ... yet
body:

ACI - Religious Liberty Survey

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osjl1AHWvN

Fellow
Patriot,

I feel
like our culture has forgotten-or ignored-some very important and
basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our
society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its
most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was
once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has
become the new normal.

Medicine
tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also
tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves,
and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not
treated as though they are alive or even human.

As a
surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you
that they are very much alive.

Life is a
precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No
person is disposable, and every life is precious according to
Him.

I believe
that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this
right by our society. I believe that together we can make a
difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also
believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe
that you believe that too.

I've
started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are
looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that
values life but that takes people like you and I making a
commitment.

The first
step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing
to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me today
and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?

I've
created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you
read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals
and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the
unborn?

body:

---
# **The Time is Now**
---
| | | | folks, Here we go again. This is the moment we have been preparing for, and now is the time to gear up. The ads are up, the doors are being knocked, the rallies are happening, **and calls and texts are going full throttle.** Both sides are determined to win. What it comes down to is which side will reach more voters and really put forward a compelling reason for why they should receive the most coveted prize of all—your vote. At No Dem Left Behind, our job is to reach voters who are not die-hard Democrats. Quite the contrary, most of the interactions we have are with folks who identify as either Independent or even leaning Republicans. Rural America is suffering right now; they feel neglected, and we are doing our best to change that. To make that change, we need to work together. **EVERYONE has a role to play,** and now is the time for all of us to decide what our role will be in helping shape the future of our country. No matter what you decide, we must all leave it all out on the field. If you are a volunteer, make sure to pick up some extra shifts, and bring a friend or two with you. If you are a donor and have the capacity to step it up, now is the time to do just that. If the only role you can play this cycle is voting, make sure you do that—and make sure you do not go alone. This cycle, we are voting together—no excuses. James, this news cycle is going to be up and down for the next couple of months. We are already seeing Fox News and the far-right media propaganda outlets completely **manufacture and spread fake news about VP Harris and the Democrats.** In addition to traditional media fabricating stories, Elon Musk and the billionaire class have joined the MAGA cult, and Twitter is being flooded with fake stories and images. These are being pushed by the algorithms in an attempt to sway vulnerable voters in the direction of Trump. This is extremely dangerous, and I guarantee we will have Congressional hearings about this after the election. The problem is, by then it might be too late. The way we counter this is by reaching more voters face-to-face. Pop-up events—we are going to be doing a lot more of those. [**_These events are expensive and time-consuming, but we have to do this in order to win. Whatever you can give, please do so today. We are going to win, and we are going to do it together._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2unz3s-estnbe-kyd76rh1/) Hassan Martini

| Hello Fellow Patriot,

Our nation is at a crossroads, facing immense challenges that threaten our values and the future we hope to build. Conservative principles like faith, liberty, community, and life are under constant attack. It's in times like these that we look to leaders who embody these values. [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=92d8015fb25f4961a0e6d605e437a280&_e=djcSTploKYuPpIVBXmH6cU4tt-Bpw5-MnxamUemBaFBCET8MA-7JpCzyj1_OQQXLt5ll1o0Bv-LWqkSKNQqCf6IyPruxJ4EOgdfpx_o9QLXk9oPNN0qe5LQVyL6aBOF0_5zp1EJORDDtGIiWPSQNc3kb-Hyp-hF7KpgMAuN91yhgsrPWsSBKfOgp0jQ10IAVlAaOb3xhRJDbKBVTDQcCKtJ4A6XtC3in0nsk0tgxqUD31nQBlq-6XuMge0yPU5AGayOU0KKC_vMOaMBYUoR5BI_XlYWICkjlWoMQCGaz0jmvETzugruREk48AgnmEIppY2lCHPVhSa0ZsIaxTr8V68_bL2W2uaB95YTulxe8SZ0eG93MATysRfDI1q-QBuG0gf0j6L84-1aPkyyw5fDTt1pI5JE__QhPunv-JCrDtsE%3D) Dr. Ben Carson has dedicated his life to these principles, serving as an accomplished neurosurgeon, a Presidential cabinet member, and a steadfast champion of conservative values. But today, Dr. Carson finds himself needing your support in a deeply personal way.

**As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Will you take a moment to[sign his birthday card](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=92d8015fb25f4961a0e6d605e437a280&_e=djcSTploKYuPpIVBXmH6cU4tt-Bpw5-MnxamUemBaFBCET8MA-7JpCzyj1_OQQXLt5ll1o0Bv-LWqkSKNQqCf6IyPruxJ4EOgdfpx_o9QLXk9oPNN0qe5LQVyL6aBOF0_5zp1EJORDDtGIiWPSQNc3kb-Hyp-hF7KpgMAuN91yhgsrPWsSBKfOgp0jQ10IAVlAaOb3xhRJDbKBVTDQcCKtJ4A6XtC3in0nsk0tgxqUD31nQBlq-6XuMge0yPU5AGViE5ZF92ez3495cimxUuSB5q176pbig2m24OD0-iShgIWnrsERMQgCevoUWFXClf1jkTrb7FxrOKEbrz0fbd8QCrtk_leHhuzJPZIjqEnLOaCBJm0rNR5K14OhXmCtHKG2blw-L4EeiG7CidL2YstRJUSI4Mleuq--paDw4pfaE%3D) and add a personal note?**

Thousands of individuals who cherish the same values have already signed the card, showing that Dr. Carson is not alone in this fight. But it will take a groundswell of support to make our collective voices heard and to show that we stand united behind leaders like Dr. Carson.

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=92d8015fb25f4961a0e6d605e437a280&_e=djcSTploKYuPpIVBXmH6cU4tt-Bpw5-MnxamUemBaFBCET8MA-7JpCzyj1_OQQXLt5ll1o0Bv-LWqkSKNQqCf6IyPruxJ4EOgdfpx_o9QLXk9oPNN0qe5LQVyL6aBOF0_5zp1EJORDDtGIiWPSQNc3kb-Hyp-hF7KpgMAuN91yhgsrPWsSBKfOgp0jQ10IAVlAaOb3xhRJDbKBVTDQcCKtJ4A6XtC3in0nsk0tgxqUD31nQBlq-6XuMge0yPU5AGb2N7ruznKOV0WHYEBqIGWG1OSvO8r8szNZtRYTEncgazrChmEcMGcXaT0PG1OYbRrExy6dHCACxE93ZSKqeRiiB7FiHPhxpkN4thdsXRiI6BY_KLTiO1wilgSJi_SYM6kcOjjN0wMmZXhdpB4PvYO9Y2T6STHv8bUUitKHzSCAE%3D)

After signing, you'll have the opportunity to further support the American Cornerstone Institute and the principles Dr. Carson represents. Your help is crucial in restoring faith, bringing patriotic education back to our schools, and healing the divisiveness that holds us back from real progress.

Thank you for your support, and may God bless you.

## Ex-NY Governor Aide Arrested as Chinese Spy
A former top aide to New York governors Kathy Hochul and Andrew Cuomo was arrested Tuesday on charges of acting as an [illegal agent of the Chinese government](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSpCAQgOGnwQwLWpAxILjEbC690EJstG8RpoDVmrff2o03_pO_vn_P5ekoUtr_uhNtC3lxvtGFy8QVB7WobrMBEXDo0EoDWumHHHR3WBmc1viYBu0DOAzePAZQq0Ew0sMkOrIgQIlJKCnEqE2_YjDabZPxEPzoHVMCN2q59P8zpXZgiO98Yel9Prtoj9ZelQ1_GMwM5vu--7T6hHf97gxmShfWRrtrlFNlMIeVuCsFa6s85HJi4S2_uKMNeXrzPV_8w7XjzY_sj8_Ii09OjtMgZVfs9ropRqqjYUrsp6P4s9F-NbksfAUAAP__9thmJg).The former aide, Linda Sun, allegedly used her high-ranking positions in state government [to serve Chinese interests](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHynCAQgPGnwW5vcAX5W1Cksbu0KZ0VFiFBuQHOzL19JqlTf803vx_P7Ukpp-v4TifbHspGrqebtwUUoNrU4G1gRp4GtqNBrfTXOOkhWrl7PeGIbnbGfCmz47LrME68SI-06CFZlKjkItUo5azNY-dgNPnFOAxudiSUZJ96qY-fJV09csifcnN9uHIO2cbeX01M3wSuAlfanbk-f5PA9VVaF7iGUk-uQMkzHOWGX9TjB2Jx8Z0hvttOlweqlVtnDyddkVrjDrGcDBQ6Vwh7gsZUXYRcrgNSy3R5geuocZ7GSQtch2r963fKObXZCCWPk1L-N9n_K3Zb_BMAAP__2ERvHw) in exchange for millions of dollars. Her husband Chris Hu was arrested on related charges.Prosecutors claim Sun blocked Taiwanese officials' access to state leaders, altered messaging on China-related issues, and facilitated unauthorized travel for Chinese officials.The couple reportedly used the money to [purchase luxury homes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFv8yAUAH-NvRHBAwwMDN-SLd_a0XqGR0yLTYRprPz7Kp07nm453cdtvmEueb__x418T3XG0POTZscUAzWrMfpEBCRH8sKAVtoKqcfVC8tRS7lYSNMiLCfjXAJ0IESiZGHMHjgo7rgSnE_aXBZKRmN0JkAKU8BBcYq513b5rHnvK6Xyqk9ql1C3sfi198cxyH8DXAe44mOn83irN7SeQ6EBrqm2jRpba1i_C8MciWFrdHSKbKeTvWr7YkFbi06TNYvVMqCMIBc5IZIK1oQ4Nh8fZy4lH5MZFL9vmMtvRf9zydPDTwAAAP__YHJjFg) and vehicles, with both pleading not guilty to the charges.
## Musk's Starlink Defies Brazil's X Ban
