| Hello Fellow Patriot,

Our nation is at a crossroads, facing immense challenges that threaten our values and the future we hope to build. Conservative principles like faith, liberty, community, and life are under constant attack. It's in times like these that we look to leaders who embody these values. [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=256e7d77ce0c4916a43204eb2366a494&_e=qks08UpO5acsm3cnaMmLAuLECh5r_fnrjhcdTaZd67YT64tjcq3lY_EiyoU9Bt_Mm51d0C_QaqbUCqC6-mv0fYMLNQsAAr1AF982nc7LMAG9Sb7C9n_8BKjdahlPWzdgZKZ_R5OU3uImP11tK4yzjkQlSFlFX8GMYsngAFYOrhW9tGeXR8QD6tyLDLBTlx1R29lwA8f8-gMJpF5llKGtoxA2gvTO_wOwO7iNM_cAV7_8W12DaDxxOWH3I1Hlm3rOHxiKxoPDhNbMimnSU3QFTi9w05mmoAu3T2hRRgycS0cmpyZVPTAwTuoDwGcNsU8WjGvz1tRt9_YDDRdcThpQalvDw7wxj9C8Ck_PuFqLua5Fwb80QqA1gs8w7f9jeH5FyAEKdsUs7B-dqcdtkMkG-ZSCAnqh4Y4sPKkANp7Ur7Q%3D) Dr. Ben Carson has dedicated his life to these principles, serving as an accomplished neurosurgeon, a Presidential cabinet member, and a steadfast champion of conservative values. But today, Dr. Carson finds himself needing your support in a deeply personal way.

**As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Will you take a moment to[sign his birthday card](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=256e7d77ce0c4916a43204eb2366a494&_e=qks08UpO5acsm3cnaMmLAuLECh5r_fnrjhcdTaZd67YT64tjcq3lY_EiyoU9Bt_Mm51d0C_QaqbUCqC6-mv0fYMLNQsAAr1AF982nc7LMAG9Sb7C9n_8BKjdahlPWzdgZKZ_R5OU3uImP11tK4yzjkQlSFlFX8GMYsngAFYOrhW9tGeXR8QD6tyLDLBTlx1R29lwA8f8-gMJpF5llKGtoxA2gvTO_wOwO7iNM_cAV7_8W12DaDxxOWH3I1Hlm3rOTMSbfPg81veGl5nwUfrnHFH70TfGaellt8zz9YLgSwlzv1qOfjLpqDU9NczkSI8tLuW-YLciA4Br8OYWz5xh6akUKepZiFIhjedfNHbXaz678j84EF3QrPGTPu2v241DmqBIAAbWMUYBSzSXtvpKMdXBx_VGj1gGnpcxNY3-MQM%3D) and add a personal note?**

Thousands of individuals who cherish the same values have already signed the card, showing that Dr. Carson is not alone in this fight. But it will take a groundswell of support to make our collective voices heard and to show that we stand united behind leaders like Dr. Carson.

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=256e7d77ce0c4916a43204eb2366a494&_e=qks08UpO5acsm3cnaMmLAuLECh5r_fnrjhcdTaZd67YT64tjcq3lY_EiyoU9Bt_Mm51d0C_QaqbUCqC6-mv0fYMLNQsAAr1AF982nc7LMAG9Sb7C9n_8BKjdahlPWzdgZKZ_R5OU3uImP11tK4yzjkQlSFlFX8GMYsngAFYOrhW9tGeXR8QD6tyLDLBTlx1R29lwA8f8-gMJpF5llKGtoxA2gvTO_wOwO7iNM_cAV7_8W12DaDxxOWH3I1Hlm3rOflV_NB_MK_B8hAgUIfJT9_qwuHjQqP0coKA82JHfqie--3loFqZQ76jMjIoylPhYvMYGSJTTfmV9zuAfGmscZbuq_ydz595Z2DAeMRrJtFKiSuFsG2ph7Diu7b-z08G3Su9vbNH1iRPaG4V3PLjtQ0Y8JRt6xSOOMNxvm-4tCOk%3D)

Thank you for your support, and may God bless you.

The American Cornerstone Institute

**Good morning!** On this day in 1839, a steamboat that [played a pivotal role](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GOhCAQxvGngU4zjKBSUFxjt9deadAZlQRlo0TXt7_s1lv9qu9L_n-P_uFDDNv861d2-TWl3o85nNzbQheoey3JDUBWSXaqQaMNmhbl4mzjW99WxHYcpxqUVggIyg7QsEEyMjgE1GBBKzB1BSVbUjWB8TQOFRIIDUwhp73MC2d--WOKdzp5L8e0yuiWnJ-HqH4EdgK767rKfCw-bTFsXKZ9Fth9VgX5uxjuNwI73vL-1jQod0fPK8QYjroRGubVh_g5z99TT4f_AQAA___bQ1Xr) in the Texas Revolution was sold. Between April 15 and 26, the Cayuga was the site at which President David Burnet and his cabinet governed the newly established Republic of Texas. A Texas family was [reunited with their cat](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL3OozAQAJ8GOqNlMX-Fi2vocu2VaGGXYMngCC-QvP3pS_31o9Fo_j3GB_ng9-df2sTpe4kjzeovGXtjDdrR5uwm4L7MxZUt1rbGusN8dS00UDbYVVPd9Qwds1jLKF1JUJNQ7h0CWujBllA3FRTSc9kw1MTzVCFDZkHYazwKXUXlTWkJn3jJUcxxy4NbVV8pq_5kOGQ43PddLPHd0pnU7z9IhsMud8pwCDGpWeK5s_l6zEKbD59kJgnxEjYzqTlEz2NPZo2bGFpUDoMAYDYfxBBfsut5SH44ft0-BJ-aNrPw3MiHb5D-vudy-D8AAP__O7hqRw), Shoto, when they got a call from an animal shelter in Massachusetts two years after he had disappeared.
Today's sponsor is [GoldCo](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kc-K3DAMh5_GuXlQ5D-ZHHIohEAPu1Bo6TFobE1isJMhdpLdty9DKRSm1VHSJz70-_k2vlGIYZneKXFXPu7rSK6Eg8dWaol61JXvbuDbuuKubtBog-aK1dw1BomulhS1t6a-gjPOsgVPbO_QYFOFDgE1tKBrMFbBhVtfWw-GvLsp9CA0sA9l3S5l5sIflO_xcz14u7g1VbGbS3lkob4IHAQO53leHtta2JWwTOkz0xGWKUtOFOKTEDjssYREheW0B8-yrHJao5e0eJlDPHiT0NSI-nlRDfnugheqb6D-NsOzvjZAPwTamIXqAWr5zmeOXApv8vvMcvjt91dboHWLUP3VGGlbI3WLINDuJY153TfHQvX_JZ9biX3Yk1D9y8RRelCYllfDauv84wwxhmwboWH684Kq_DvCo8NfAQAA__9AhZ1K) offering a free guide to buying Gold IRA's.

## Paxton Targets Unsolicited Voter Registration
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has [threatened to sue](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxsUD2PozAQ_TWmm8gMhkBBcQ3dXntlNB4PYK2xI9sbkn9_SrqTrn2feu_P1-2LfPBx-02HzPW5phtx9Q-5TWAAzc00brbaTW0jc3vF3vTYj9jsc0-u69eBJrH6KqN1ZhyFB5461mxH1_gZNRo9adPqfuj0RSbXDk735Nh26LQyWpyvKV_qLlWeVNbwSg_JF05HE-a91ntR3S-Fi8LlPM_L955-3qTChXL1HEThEuUsCpeQmILCZaecfQFOP7G-FC6fYKANviXCnZ41RTgpRx83CFKrZPjHApyOw5fiU5T8AXOFR3rrsmy-1EzVpwhryse7F8ceWNZx0HYCcWsLhq8E1vIKjK41EwuTs02e3f30IfgyXJXR20E-fJbW___-mPFvAAAA__9qpIpH) Bexar and Harris counties if they follow through on plans to mail voter registration forms to "unverified recipients" who might not be eligible to participate in the upcoming election. ## Dennis Quaid Stars in "Reagan"
Houston-born actor Dennis Quaid stars in a [newly released film](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnsTes8xnsMjB0yZauHa0DjgQVm8gg47591c7df-mXvs_7eqeY4v74oI1NvUJeydV48qqFFChX2XtjweuxZzMuqKRC9Yb901g_-zAFInTTqFRwFhg0QcCFFmWpjwYBJWiQI6h5goG1H2cPiryzE3roJLCPNR9DfXLli0pI3_nkY3B565N51voq3fTe4a3DW2tt2LmVxvz1G3R4O_JOyYuD6UG72PIZWVimWoTNl8ghRMeCrxe7SjXmvYhRy0XOuj-Mf7WYUizz0kl4bBTT37X-b3Aa_AkAAP__Q5tg5w) about Ronald Reagan that surpassed box office expectations in its first weekend, earning $7.4 million to rank fourth in estimated ticket sales. Directed by Sean McNamara, known for "Soul Surfer" and "Miracle Season," the biopic examines the life of the 40th president from his childhood to the White House, focusing on his fight against communism in Hollywood and the Soviet Union. subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=def7da57d4d94d7bb81699b49732bc28&_e=q2VlCDQyhcPZuI1JBJU5e0ccsMkL5mOlPybC2ClmEwWnlSUzHlw_G83PKywOfSIh4sZrMhuJ_xOsY1uNKFOR1kKXqZeAcqPMHffr6hXLvcdqihIJJGJY5UdF-wtcxBKPDp8srtOGmSJJ44eNBQiYjQt6-rsY1GmMkUDD-62JmIgKIgeB7Ey1kaXTW5LKh5yu_1J1cEZOBh76fZKaKBEyUiAv9iw02PSKhCrKWfvlJjdMVWdniepaj7cG91twz3KsA-XTlSz9kVvIj-uOb-_BxSgVMcb2JIKjV2YRdmoRkY3ZwdwXkckoyd8Dk9CBdvEc6Qqzj55O3Q-zwzi_qWbTEczWCqJKQzmkz7RhzjolfENDo74n9XULzuieRJLjuzR8iNoyJorKsyMvtuYwEMw2ncUPo_AG-4nM4FGYFMViMd_1abGMy6jeSCs19QUkiIEe)

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative. Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=def7da57d4d94d7bb81699b49732bc28&_e=q2VlCDQyhcPZuI1JBJU5e0ccsMkL5mOlPybC2ClmEwWnlSUzHlw_G83PKywOfSIh4sZrMhuJ_xOsY1uNKFOR1kKXqZeAcqPMHffr6hXLvcdqihIJJGJY5UdF-wtcxBKPDp8srtOGmSJJ44eNBQiYjQt6-rsY1GmMkUDD-62JmIgKIgeB7Ey1kaXTW5LKh5yu_1J1cEZOBh76fZKaKBEyUiAv9iw02PSKhCrKWfvlJjdMVWdniepaj7cG91twz3KsA-XTlSz9kVvIj-uOb-_BxbcndVEcBpM284iY8G0lcjQpJcg7yE3k0VmWyL9_kc8H5ARvLeczCDsDKTBw4zdDkQ3keyiTRptSLHvbM9yOid4smQ2egPUID-5Z5JzJGjS7bZKw5FFxJrgD8pUW35uPin8vYHcLudlQcn6rTz1md-yVAYsJ0Lt81v061sQjdT_G)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. | Hello Fellow Patriot,

Our nation is at a crossroads, facing immense challenges that threaten our values and the future we hope to build. Conservative principles like faith, liberty, community, and life are under constant attack. It's in times like these that we look to leaders who embody these values. [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff1671a3bdf440bb920dadf31399f0c&_e=7c4EOEbBXII6EvFZnbuhTE4jFNwjdab5o4dYFTr1hfSJ2p8zokcE-BKUCLCFvGWu1IwHt6fsfP8vpQtjN7tGbxazKIJyX6_EEA2AquoijadZ9kzJt4dVSZm6j5bJN6X3HbPSUNOXg8drII0RjsvkzU6Zl2ZI3CwA2QtcrHr-WYcKsoK4DFyqJBAx9CspvlupONnzSHGxq3aanMEyHZczAjEh0X2ursQ379hgKuH2YIk29seHMH3DLH9gciy2Wlf2VhwVA5JhSYJJOReyANgzbchZKln07j-Sy8LGVkQaw0XTVv6ZJdWP3beGNo0pJDKSj84JXR8aU645ieeSt0Yq-6b8--4xFv1f_j_AWgkV5ho1C19MTzb0NF5SjhRPTwJ2DSBPwCd6OLrW_Zua7MQW_ebQ1RMNcjRD8uhJC_njnQY%3D) Dr. Ben Carson has dedicated his life to these principles, serving as an accomplished neurosurgeon, a Presidential cabinet member, and a steadfast champion of conservative values. But today, Dr. Carson finds himself needing your support in a deeply personal way.

**As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Will you take a moment to[sign his birthday card](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff1671a3bdf440bb920dadf31399f0c&_e=7c4EOEbBXII6EvFZnbuhTE4jFNwjdab5o4dYFTr1hfSJ2p8zokcE-BKUCLCFvGWu1IwHt6fsfP8vpQtjN7tGbxazKIJyX6_EEA2AquoijadZ9kzJt4dVSZm6j5bJN6X3HbPSUNOXg8drII0RjsvkzU6Zl2ZI3CwA2QtcrHr-WYcKsoK4DFyqJBAx9CspvlupONnzSHGxq3aanMEyHZczAjEh0X2ursQ379hgKuH2YIk29seHMH3DLH9gciy2Wlf2kfFJACu8JMJj9C8MOc0jEM4sSxn-yj3DkuiY0IZTy9H0nqYS9FiWrcftRjhl5f-hwvcenJQSBcAHLRvpacZLE93K1P41D9QffzkFOJRkeSI8ExASveb-hgTvROMrwScv8ARzmzUUKH796xog7j5D-pEnK2EwOGiOrv6JyYkrkEY%3D) and add a personal note?**

Thousands of individuals who cherish the same values have already signed the card, showing that Dr. Carson is not alone in this fight. But it will take a groundswell of support to make our collective voices heard and to show that we stand united behind leaders like Dr. Carson.

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ff1671a3bdf440bb920dadf31399f0c&_e=7c4EOEbBXII6EvFZnbuhTE4jFNwjdab5o4dYFTr1hfSJ2p8zokcE-BKUCLCFvGWu1IwHt6fsfP8vpQtjN7tGbxazKIJyX6_EEA2AquoijadZ9kzJt4dVSZm6j5bJN6X3HbPSUNOXg8drII0RjsvkzU6Zl2ZI3CwA2QtcrHr-WYcKsoK4DFyqJBAx9CspvlupONnzSHGxq3aanMEyHZczAjEh0X2ursQ379hgKuH2YIk29seHMH3DLH9gciy2Wlf2c4SeIvoDjbb8HFHqS8QS3As3fnxA36gXSOfFG5frcEUR2L1IXWMbch07c6E5o8lYvepfy4dVwNPnBZGRrvNwVIz0Q5Vh1jHIB6niM3bXw25AfgQ9WuO82MB3K588_OfIkYrEG06u40svt2UdGOtWCXLlPeAMHrpujLPRgnuDNmQ%3D)

After signing, you'll have the opportunity to further support the American Cornerstone Institute and the principles Dr. Carson represents. Your help is crucial in restoring faith, bringing patriotic education back to our schools, and healing the divisiveness that holds us back from real progress.

Thank you for your support, and may God bless you.

The American Cornerstone Institute

Bitcoin and Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) are two different forms of digital currency with distinct features. While CBDCs have the backing of central banks and governments, Bitcoin has several unique characteristics that make it a better option for many users.
One of the main advantages of Bitcoin is its decentralization. Unlike CBDCs, which are issued and controlled by central authorities, Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network of computers, making it resistant to censorship and manipulation. This means that users have more control over their funds and can transact with greater privacy.
Another advantage of Bitcoin is its limited supply. There will only ever be 21 million Bitcoins in existence, which makes it a deflationary currency. This is in contrast to CBDCs, which can be issued and inflated by central banks at their discretion. As a result, Bitcoin is often seen as a better store of value and hedge against inflation.
Bitcoin is also more accessible than CBDCs. Anyone with an internet connection can use Bitcoin, regardless of their location or financial status. This makes it a powerful tool for financial inclusion, allowing people in unbanked and underbanked regions to participate in the global economy.
Finally, Bitcoin has a proven track record of security and reliability. The Bitcoin network has been operating for over a decade without any major security breaches or downtime. This is a testament to the robustness of the technology and the strength of the community that supports it.
In conclusion, Bitcoin offers unique features that make it a better option. Its decentralization, limited supply, accessibility, and security make it a powerful tool for financial freedom and inclusion.

clean_body: Bitcoin and Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) are two different forms of digital currency with distinct features and advantages. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? from the desk ofDana Criswell | | | Sep 4 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Photo by on Bitcoin and Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) are two different forms of digital currency with distinct features. While CBDCs have the backing of central banks and governments, Bitcoin has several unique characteristics that make it a better option for many users. One of the main advantages of Bitcoin is its decentralization. Unlike CBDCs, which are issued and controlled by central authorities, Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network of computers, making it resistant to censorship and manipulation. This means that users have more control over their funds and can transact with greater privacy. Another advantage of Bitcoin is its limited supply. There will only ever be 21 million Bitcoins in existence, which makes it a deflationary currency. This is in contrast to CBDCs, which can be issued and inflated by central banks at their discretion. As a result, Bitcoin is often seen as a better store of value and hedge against inflation. Bitcoin is also more accessible than CBDCs. Anyone with an internet connection can use Bitcoin, regardless of their location or financial status. This makes it a powerful tool for financial inclusion, allowing people in unbanked and underbanked regions to participate in the global economy. Finally, Bitcoin has a proven track record of security and reliability. The Bitcoin network has been operating for over a decade without any major security breaches or downtime. This is a testament to the robustness of the technology and the strength of the community that supports it. In conclusion, Bitcoin offers unique features that make it a better option. Its decentralization, limited supply, accessibility, and security make it a powerful tool for financial freedom and inclusion. body:

* * *

_- From The Desk Of -_
**MAJORITY LEADER STEVE SCALISE**

* * *

Listen up, Patriot:

**The first ballots in the 2024 General Election will hit mailboxes in North Carolina in just 48 HOURS! **

The Democrats aren't waiting until November to start banking votes. They're starting the second early voting begins. That's why we need to move right now to help save Conservatives in swing states.

- The Harris-Walz Campaign just _cut a $10 million check_ specifically to obliterate Conservative campaigns in can't-lose House races.
- House Democrats' favorite Super PAC just reserved over _$210 million_ in ads to barnstorm swing states in order to sway undecided voters.

- The DCCC announced they just knocked _377,700 doors_ and made _845,500 phone calls_ to voters in must-win districts.

_I hate coming to you with this, but we 're short on time and out of options. I'm humbly asking you to chip in a few bucks right here and right now to save the day._

**There is NOTHING more important than fully funding block-and-tackle campaign infrastructure like this. Everyone agrees it 'll mean the difference between victory and defeat. **

Regardless, thanks for all you do. Your support means everything.

God bless you,

Steve Scalise

Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/yONhbvZX4a3f6de6zkMFLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRouuO8P0RlaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8zZDdhZWYzOC00YTM3LTRlNjUtYTRjOC00Nzc0NDkzYjFkNzU_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONTQzNjhXA3NwY0IKZs_YSNhmVDYUVFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)_
---
[**Make your gift & get your FREE book**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/yONhbvZX4a3f6de6zkMFLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRouuO8P0RlaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90dXJuaW5nLXBvaW50LXVzYS8zZDdhZWYzOC00YTM3LTRlNjUtYTRjOC00Nzc0NDkzYjFkNzU_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONTQzNjhXA3NwY0IKZs_YSNhmVDYUVFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---
Friend, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

Vice President Harris couldn't have put it better when she said, _"In many ways, Donald Trump is an unserious man, but the consequences of putting Donald Trump back in the White House are extremely serious."_

That's because the MAGA power grab known as Project 2025 would cost the economy billions, jack up household bills, and poison our communities—all while robbing us of a safe and equitable climate future.

We don't take this threat lightly, which is why **we have an ambitious, actionable new climate plan ready for a Harris presidency to push forward.** And we have new numbers that show how stark the choice is between these two futures: |

subject: Thank you for being an important part of this crucial work

body:
Ending map manipulation has a profound impact on our society. There’s a ton of work ahead, but for today — a simple “thank you.”
|
---

Peter,
End-of-month deadlines can be a lot. Thank you so much for supporting AOTL through it all. We will have other deadlines and goals, but I realized we only have two more “end-of-months” together before the November election. Whoa.
Our offices were closed on Monday in observance of Labor Day — our national holiday created to honor and celebrate the contributions of workers and labor unions across the country.
In my home state of Michigan, this was the first Labor Day since the 2023 repeal of its anti-union “right-to-work” legislation. Despite some good branding and communications work, it’s becoming more widely known that “right-to-work” laws hurt workers — they actually result in lower wages and benefits.
As someone who thinks all workers should have access to decent wages and job security, I was proud when Michigan recently became the first state in 58 years (!!!) to repeal its right-to-work laws.
**And I could connect the dots between the historic progress Michigan is making for workers and the work we’re doing here together at AOTL for fair maps.**
For years, Michigan had notoriously been home to some of the most gerrymandered political maps in the country. Democrats were winning the majority of votes but Republicans were still winning majorities in the legislature.
In 2018, Michigan voters, tired of not being fairly represented, passed a ballot initiative to move the redistricting process from the legislature to an independent commission.
**And in 2022, the _very first_ election that leveraged new maps from the independent commission, Democrats won a majority for the first time in 40 years. **And that progressive majority was able to repeal the right-to-work laws that had been hurting Michigan families for decades.
So, Peter, you helped make that happen!
And it’s not just Michigan. With your support, we’re hard at work across the country making sure the actions of our government reflect the will of the people. That includes undoing gerrymanders, enacting redistricting reforms like independent commissions, and mobilizing voters ahead of November.
Ending map manipulation has a profound impact on our society. **There’s a ton of work ahead but for today, just a simple “thank you.”**
Brianna Shamsuddoha,
Director of Mobilization, All On The Line

name: Jill Stein
subject: This isn’t heartwarming - it’s horrifying
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Let’s talk about the state of American healthcare.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=american_healthcare&n=1)
---
Peter,

11-year-old Teddy sold lemonade to pay for his surgeries after being hit by a car.

7-year-old Liza set up shop in front of her mother’s bakery, selling treats to pay for her brain surgery.

9-year-old Forrest raised money to pay for his father’s kidney transplant.

Each one of these stories was reported on by local media as a “heartwarming” feel-good story about good-old fashioned American resilience.

This isn’t heartwarming. It’s a horror show.

It’s a damning condemnation of the state of the American healthcare system – and I should know.

Long before I launched my first campaign for office, I served for over two decades as a doctor of Internal Medicine.

I, too, had to navigate the labyrinth of private insurance and the myriad of traps set by insurance executives to wriggle out of paying for essential healthcare.

I, too, had to comfort patients who were confronted with a diagnosis they couldn’t afford to treat – to talk them through the gut-wrenching decisions of rationing care so their families could afford groceries and rent.

_This system is evil, and it has to change.

_ The Democratic party is _still_ running on “protecting” the Affordable Care Act as the solution to the healthcare crisis in America.

In 2010, the year the ACA was signed into law, approximately 48.6 million Americans were uninsured. Today, with all the gaps still present under the ACA, the number of uninsured stands at an estimated 27.1 million.

That seems like an improvement, until you realize that the combined total of uninsured and under-insured people – 77.6 million in 2010 to 86.1 million in 2024 – has actually INCREASED.

**Today, roughly 58 million Americans are considered under-insured, meaning that they have health insurance plans so fundamentally dysfunctional that they serve no practical use to the patient – and only serve to line the pockets of insurance executives.

** You’re probably on one of these plans – one with premiums, deductibles, and out-of-pocket minimums so outrageous that even going to the urgent care center for a sinus infection could land you in $1K of medical debt.

Obama had the chance to make the first steps towards universal healthcare and put a public option into the ACA. Instead he caved to his donors in the insurance industry.

Today we have MORE Americans living with medical debt in 2024 than we did before the ACA.

**_This is the current reality of healthcare in America, under the Democrats’ signature healthcare policy:_**
* **26 million Americans still have NO health insurance at all.

**
* **Up to 43% of American adults remain UNDER-insured** – meaning that your health insurance doesn’t cover your basic medical expenses.

* **41% (or 73 MILLION) Americans are in debt for medical bills.

**
* **At least 68,000 Americans die every year because they can’t access affordable healthcare.**

But you know who isn’t suffering? Health insurance companies. Their profits have nearly DOUBLED since 2010 thanks to millions of new mandatory customers on slipshod insurance plans.

Americans spend more on healthcare than any other country on earth for the privilege of living sicker and dying younger than ANY of our peer nations.

_But it doesn’t have to be this way.

_**Universal healthcare is fully within our grasp, and it is the only solution to the tangled mess of the privatized American healthcare system that leaves millions falling through the cracks.

** Imagine a world where you don’t have to pay a copay to see a doctor or collect a prescription.

Imagine a world where you don’t have to spend hours on the phone to find out if your preferred doctor is in network – or to get your visit covered if they’re not.

Imagine a world where, when you are sick, you simply go to the doctor – and they treat you.

No deductibles. No co-pays. No mandatory minimums and no lifetime maximums. Just healthcare.

**[That is not a wild fantasy. That is the reality in dozens of countries around the world – and it could be our reality, too. Our campaign is fighting to guarantee no American struggles, suffers, or dies because they can’t get basic healthcare.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=american_healthcare&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=american_healthcare&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=american_healthcare&n=3)
---
When Democrats tell you that healthcare is a human right, what they really mean is that healthcare has the right to be profitable for insurance carriers.

My vision for healthcare is radically different – shaped by decades of experience as a physician and a lifetime of activism.

When I am president, we will push Congress to immediately expand and implement a national Medicare for All program that covers every single American from birth.

We will move to cancel ALL medical debt and to codify patients’ rights (including the right to an abortion and all bodily autonomy).

We will restore public trust in government agencies with transparency and effective oversight, and shut the revolving door between regulatory bodies like the FDA and CDC and the multibillion dollar corporations they are supposed to govern.

All of this **[and a whole lot more](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=american_healthcare&n=4)** is attainable.

As your president, my highest responsibility will be the safety and well-being of our people and our planet – not the profits of multinational corporations or the robber barons in the executive suite.

**Ours is the ONLY campaign with a path to the White House this November with the credibility and experience to establish healthcare as an unalienable human right. I need your support to reach the millions of Americans who are still looking for a candidate who shares their priorities. Will you donate today?**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=american_healthcare&n=5 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=american_healthcare&n=5)
---
Human health has always been inextricably connected with society. It’s a question of what and WHO we choose to invest in.

I choose us.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

**As you know, Democrats only need to flip FOUR seats to win back the House this November.** Make no mistake about it; if we can’t get rid of Speaker Mike Johnson, we’ll have another two years of chaos and hyperpartisanship in Washington. **
** Democrats have campaigns in every corner of the country. We’re just over 60 days until the election. Arizona could be the state that decides it all. I’m hoping I can count on you to get us over the top.
#

Peter -
Over the last few weeks I have been all over Arizona. It's one of my favorite parts of the campaign. We've got an incredibly diverse and culturally rich state, and everywhere I go I meet people who understand the value of that.
They get how important it is that no matter our background, no matter where our parents or grandparents are from, we are all Americans. And it is up to each of us to work together to improve our community and our country.
It's the same lesson I learned in the Marines. Guys from every corner of the country put aside our differences to protect each other and get the day's mission done.
That's a lesson we could afford to learn a little better in Washington, but it's one that I know you get, Peter.
Just by being a part of my team you’ve told me that you have a good idea of what we’re trying to do here. But if we’re going to win in Arizona, I’m going to need you to take the next step.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1873%2E135344%2Eb9IGnm)

Friend --
Sometimes it shocks me that anyone donates to fundraising emails from political campaigns.
If you're anything like me, you open your email in the morning and it's overflowing with emails from every Senate campaign, House campaign, the presidential campaign, party committees, and organizations you know and likely many you've never heard of. Most of the time I haven’t signed up for these lists.
I get why these emails happen: they are an increasingly important part of how campaigns and organizations are funded. Especially on the Democratic side. Our small dollar, online, and texting programs are light-years more productive than the GOP, and often account for a third of our monthly fundraising.
So in a sea of Democratic emails and texts, I do my best to differentiate our content, and edit every single one, including this one. The fact that you opened this email instead of deleting it and made it this far gives me hope there's a chance.
There is no winning the Senate without this race in Michigan. There is no winning the White House either. At the same time, this is going to be one of the most competitive (and expensive) races in the country. Poll after poll shows it razor tight.
Republicans know that too, that is why they'll put ridiculous amounts of money in to beat us. And since I don’t accept corporate PAC money, I have to rely on the generosity of individuals like you who understand the stakes of this race.
Hopefully that's a compelling case. It’s my job to make it. Because there's no winning this race without a significant response to emails like this by people like you.
[**Would you consider contributing $3 to my Senate campaign in Michigan to help me hold this seat, and the Senate, for Democrats in November? I can’t win without the help of people like you.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240904-1-900&t=2&akid=1873%2E135344%2Eb9IGnm)**

# Department of Education Helps Medical Lake School District Educate Kids in Military Families!
---
|
Every child deserves access to a public school education that prepares them for their future, regardless of where they grow up. This builds the foundation for children’s lives and makes our country strong. To ensure quality education is available to all, we must ensure that public money goes to public education. Before the long weekend Carmela visited with the superintendent of the Medical Lake School District, Dr. Kimberly Headrick, to learn about the Department of Education Federal Impact Program. Impact Funding reimburses public schools serving students from military families, ensuring a quality education for them and students from non-military families alike. MLSD serves 800 students living on and around Fairchild Air Force Base, and we are proud that these families add to the culture and community of our region. Carmela is committed to ensuring that public money is spent on public education. The Washington Education Association and the National Education Association have both endorsed Carmela Conroy for Congress.

Please read her message below, and then consider splitting a contribution between my campaign and hers._ __Thank you! – Dan__
* * *
_[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92140716/496129859/-741272818?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240904_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTczNmQ1MC1jOTZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tRcnJp2v4Ewp1GkEjQHKie-eJFTDaLP7dOMt09NCVXA=)_ Hi Peter, **I’m running for Congress to represent New Hampshire's Second Congressional District!** | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92140717/496129860/-741272818?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240904_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTczNmQ1MC1jOTZhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tRcnJp2v4Ewp1GkEjQHKie-eJFTDaLP7dOMt09NCVXA=)

I was born and raised in New Hampshire. I love this state. But I don't love what's happening in our country. Extremist politicians and judges are taking away our rights and freedoms. Reproductive rights are under attack. Corporate monopolies are jacking up prices for housing, health care, and groceries.
These bullies have too much power in America.
I've spent my career holding corrupt politicians and corporations accountable, and I'm ready to deliver for New Hampshire on Day One in Congress.
New Hampshire has been my family's home for over 100 years and the Granite State made me who I am today. I grew up down the road from the farm my great-grandfather built after he immigrated to America. My mom served in our State House and ran for this same seat when I was just shy of two years old.
The Granite State is where I learned the values that I've fought for my entire life. As a foreign policy advisor in Congress, I helped write landmark sanctions legislation and worked to strengthen democracy around the world. I served as an intelligence officer in the United States Navy Reserve for over a decade and as counsel in the first impeachment of former President Donald Trump.
After President Biden was elected, I served at the Justice Department, where I took on corporate monopolies as a Deputy Assistant Attorney General. Then I went to the White House, where I led President Biden's Unity Agenda, dedicated to solving five big challenges: beating the opioid epidemic, tackling the mental health crisis, holding Big Tech accountable, meeting our sacred obligation to veterans, and ending cancer as we know it.

This disturbing incident should have never occurred and is a direct consequence of policies enacted by Democrats at both the national and state levels.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale commented on the appalling situation, stating, "This incident is vile. I am appalled by the utter failure of the Biden-Harris Administration's immigration policies and the cowardice displayed by the Democratic supermajority in Massachusetts for not doing more to protect our residents from predators who are in the Commonwealth illegally. The Biden-Harris Administration's reckless approach to the border crisis has led to assaults across the country."
Carnevale continued, "This is just one incident that we know of. Due to the Healey-Driscoll Administration's veil of secrecy surrounding the migrant crisis, residents remain in the dark about 600 incidents involving police, fire, and EMS services at taxpayer-funded emergency housing for migrants. These crimes are serious, this crisis is serious, and it's entirely reasonable for residents to fear that the situation is worse than what we currently know. The Healey-Driscoll Administration must be transparent with their constituents and release the unredacted documents regarding the incidents that have occurred in emergency housing."
"We submitted FOIA requests on August 27th, and the administration has 10 business days to respond from that date. Massachusetts residents are demanding answers," Carnevale concluded.

subject: Next week! NHGOP Unity Breakfast September 12
body:
logo

** NHGOP United in Victory Breakfast
------------------------------------------------------------

** Thursday, September 12
------------------------------------------------------------

** Doors Open 8am
------------------------------------------------------------

The primary season will soon be behind us, and it will be the time to quickly come together as one strong, united Republican team!

We are excited to invite you to the NHGOP Unity Breakfast on September 12th, where we will rally together and prepare for the critical challenges ahead on the path to November.

Event Details:

Date: Thursday, September 12, 2024
Time: Doors open 8am. Breakfast & Program 8:30am to 10:00am.
Location: Grappone Conference Center, 70 Constitution Ave Concord NH

This is our opportunity to put any differences behind us and focus on our shared goal: victory in November to keep our state SANE.

Whether you're a candidate, supporter, or volunteer, your presence is vital as we launch the final phase of our campaign. Let's show New Hampshire that the GOP is stronger and more united than ever.

We owe a headcount for breakfast tomorrow so please get your tickets today!

Thank you for your commitment to our shared Republican values. Together, we will win!

Looking forward to seeing you there,

Chris Ager
Chairman, NHGOP

P.S. Let’s show the strength of a united GOP. We need everyone on board to ensure a successful November!

I’m sorry, but this email is _not_ announcing a new Star Wars movie. It’s about something much more serious: our Democracy. This November, we have the opportunity to elect a woman who will bring grace and joy to the White House. **We have a shot at ousting the MAGA majority in Congress.** And, we have a chance to get rid of Trump for good (did you see he said he’d leave the country if he loses?! November 5th really can’t come soon enough). But to flip the House this November and get Kamala Harris the team she needs in Congress, we need to go all in supporting the right candidates. I’m here to tell you that **Michelle Vallejo is the right candidate.** She’s a daughter of immigrants, a small business owner, and a fierce community advocate. And yet, for some reason, more and more Americans look to government as the solution to their problems.

* **Analyze the continuing social and economic problems as government intervention increases in the U.S.**

* **Demonstrate how and why government is the problem.**

I really think you'll get a lot out of this eBook. It's a favorite among supporters of Hoover. And although some of the particulars have changed since he wrote this in 1993, I think you'll find the situation is frighteningly similar today.

Folks,
We are almost at the pivot point.
We've been focused on voter registration all year -- it's been our number one priority, starting with reengaging lapsed voters and attracting new voters to our outreach on the ground and advertising online. Now that we've put in all that effort, our focus is starting to pivot to voter mobilization.
We’ll continue to use proven tactics to contact voters — directly and indirectly — to make sure this critical election stays top of mind. We’re blanketing our targeted states with text messages, emails, digital advertising, and more, all with one simple focus: I ncreasing voter turnout.
This is hugely important because voting is a habit that lasts a lifetime . New voters will become voters who make their voices heard on state and local issues that impact communities across the country. If more people vote, our policies and elected leaders will be more representative of the population. This is our unique opportunity to surge voters to the polls, and we need your help to do it.

Peter, this is probably the longest email you’ll ever get from
me.

But it’s also one of the most important, so it really would mean a lot to
me if you could read through it.

If you’re in a hurry or if you’re already sold and ready to do whatever it
takes to help me defeat Larry Hogan and defend our Senate majority,
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/30642?t=1010&amount=25&akid=2390%2E52803%2Ea6tgVI ]then please consider making a quick grassroots contribution to give us
the resources and momentum to win this race in just 9 weeks!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/30642?t=1011&amount=25&akid=2390%2E52803%2Ea6tgVI ]Donate

I want to outline our campaign message going forward for the General
Election to fill Maryland’s open U.S. Senate seat. It hinges on 3 major
components:

Power to the People

This campaign has never been about me,
Peter. It’s always been about
Marylanders, our families, and our communities.

And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic
Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country.

That’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race. But
during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by the many,
not by the money.

We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark
money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots
coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to
volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign.

Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary
victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win in
November.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his
divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to
people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving
our democracy.

My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that
as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to
abortion care throughout the state.

He’s banking on Marylanders forgetting that he vetoed a $15 minimum wage
and legislation to benefit unions and workers.

He’s hoping Marylanders won’t realize that electing him means handing
control of the Senate over to extremists like Ted Cruz and Lindsey Graham.

On the issues that matter most, Hogan’s record speaks for itself: He’s all
wrong for Maryland, and he’ll say and do whatever he thinks will win him
this seat.

Make the Case for a Democratic Senate Majority

Here’s the truth,
Peter: There simply isn’t any
way Democrats maintain our razor-thin Senate majority if Larry Hogan wins
this open seat.

Mitch McConnell handpicked Hogan for this race because he sees Maryland as
his best chance to flip a seat, retake the majority, and enact his
far-right, anti-choice agenda.

If the GOP retakes the Senate, they'll have the power to pass a national
abortion ban, roll back environmental protections, undermine our
elections, and so much more.

Hogan has proven that he cannot be trusted to protect our reproductive
rights or put Maryland families first. Defending the Senate is the only
way to protect our freedoms, uplift working families, and preserve our
democracy.

We’ve got a winning message that’s resonating with voters,
Peter, and I need your support
to make sure everyone hears it. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/30642?t=1012&amount=25&akid=2390%2E52803%2Ea6tgVI ]Can I count on you to chip in $25 to
give our grassroots team the resources we need to reach Marylanders across
the state?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

Together,

Angela Alsobrooks

subject: September is Suicide Prevention Month

body:
Here at GIFFORDS, our mission is to save lives from gun violence, and that includes the lives of people who may be contemplating suicide.
#

_*** The following email is about the role of guns in death by suicide. If you or a loved one are contemplating suicide, please know you are not alone. Call or text the free and confidential National Suicide Prevention Lifeline at 988, or visit 988lifeline.org. ***_
Friends -
September is Suicide Prevention Month. Here at GIFFORDS, our mission is to save lives from gun violence, and that includes the lives of people who may be contemplating suicide. Three in five gun deaths in the US are self-inflicted, and about 67 people die by firearm suicide each day in our country. These are heartbreaking statistics, and ones that we are working every day to change.
Evidence shows that when it comes to suicide, gun access can mean the difference between life and death. Because guns are so much more lethal than other common means of suicide, people who attempt to take their own life with a gun often aren’t given a second chance.
Everyone deserves that second chance, and it’s why we won’t stop in our work to improve access to mental health care, to help implement extreme risk protection orders in states nationwide, and to advocate for comprehensive safe storage laws.
[**Today, we’re asking you to contribute to GIFFORDS PAC—any amount you can afford. Your donation will help us continue our work to save lives from gun violence and prevent firearm suicides.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240904-1-30&t=1&akid=8853%2E3935704%2EtUTQP8)

Everyday Americans are trying to figure out how to afford their lives — and one of the biggest issues is whether they can afford their rent or even realize the American dream of buying their own home.
What I admire about what Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz have proposed is that it’s a commonsense, practical, and realistic proposal for how we can address this crisis by boosting the housing supply and setting a bold goal of building 3 million new apartments and houses over the next five years.
And, just as importantly, the Harris-Walz administration will make sure the corporate landlords that are swooping in and buying up homes, turning them into rentals, and jacking up the prices are held accountable.
When it comes to the housing crisis, the difference between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump is vast. Trump, a convicted criminal, **_was sued for housing discrimination_**. He didn’t do anything about this problem when he was president, and we certainly can’t count on him to address the housing crisis if he becomes president again.
**I’ve been working on housing in the Senate for years. We know what we need to do, we just need the will to get it done — and the Harris-Walz administration will tackle this issue head-on.**

clean_body: | Folks, Our country needs bold solutions to address the housing crisis — and the Harris-Walz plan is exactly what we need at this moment. | Everyday Americans are trying to figure out how to afford their lives — and one of the biggest issues is whether they can afford their rent or even realize the American dream of buying their own home. What I admire about what Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz have proposed is that it’s a commonsense, practical, and realistic proposal for how we can address this crisis by boosting the housing supply and setting a bold goal of building 3 million new apartments and houses over the next five years. And, just as importantly, the Harris-Walz administration will make sure the corporate landlords that are swooping in and buying up homes, turning them into rentals, and jacking up the prices are held accountable. When it comes to the housing crisis, the difference between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump is vast. Trump, a convicted criminal, was sued for housing discrimination. He didn’t do anything about this problem when he was president, and we certainly can’t count on him to address the housing crisis if he becomes president again. I’ve been working on housing in the Senate for years. We know what we need to do, we just need the will to get it done — and the Harris-Walz administration will tackle this issue head-on. Together, we can take meaningful action and help millions of Americans achieve their dream of home ownership. subject: Social Media Censorship...A Very Real Threat to Our Elections!
body:
Judicial Watch is leading the charge to for honest elections...by forcing states to clean their voter rolls, and by defending time-tested safeguards that protect against voter fraud and allowing noncitizens to vote in our elections.

| Dear Fellow American,

As you know, Judicial Watch is leading the charge to for honest elections...by forcing states to clean their voter rolls, and by defending time-tested safeguards that protect against voter fraud and allowing noncitizens to vote in our elections.
But we are also in the forefront of another vital fight...uncovering government efforts to censor free speech and suppress opposition.
Believe me, this fight is also _directly related to honest elections_...
[**And that's why I am asking for you to give us your support with a special contribution today.**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69971&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69971&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

A Judicial Watch lawsuit recently forced the release of records from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) that show state election officials in the days before and after the 2020 elections flagging content they deemed "misinformation" and sending it to federal government agencies, including one created to _suppress_ online election content.

Why is this important?

Because it is just one more piece of disturbing evidence that Judicial Watch has uncovered of a conspiracy by federal, state, and 'private' actors to censor Americans... especially _conservative_ Americans!

In fact, just last week, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg admitted in a _bombshell letter_ to House Judiciary Committee Chairman Rep. Jim Jordan that his company, Facebook, was pressured by the Biden-Harris administration to censor Americans, particularly regarding Covid-19 content!

This censorship is un-American, and is clearly designed to help government, in conjunction with Big Tech, influence public policy...and even the outcome of our elections!

_We are now just two months away from another national election_ , and Judicial Watch is committed to exposing government's involvement in an ongoing and unprecedented attack on all Americans' First Amendment rights related to campaigns, elections, and other important public policy debates.

That's why I counting on you to help us again, at this critically important time!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69971&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**With the help of members and supporters, we have already****:**

* **Forced the release of documents** showing that state officials in California and Iowa pressured social media companies to censor posts about the 2020 election.

* **Filed a lawsuit** against the California Secretary of State for having YouTube censor a Judicial Watch election integrity video.

* **Filed lawsuits** against the Departments of Justice for records of communications between the FBI and social media sites regarding foreign influence in U.S. elections, as well as the Hunter Biden laptop story.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69971&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**And we are exposing this ugly conspiracy on other fronts as well!**

* **We uncovered records** from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) which revealed that Facebook coordinated closely with the CDC to control the COVID narrative and "misinformation," and that over $3.5 million in free advertising was given to the CDC by social media companies.

* **We filed a lawsuit** against the U.S. Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) for records concerning censorship of social media users.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69971&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

No other government watchdog has worked as doggedly Judicial Watch to get to the facts about the censorship alliance between government and Big Tech...

...and _we must be ready to investigate credible evidence of any efforts by the Biden-Harris administration and Big Tech_ to censor our free speech rights and limit our access to information and opinion in the weeks before the November 5th elections!

Thank you for your commitment to the rule of law...and thank you in advance for your help today.

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69971&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7df75068f57b476d85b342b5231ec98b&_e=TIgqkdFDn8AaNXMDBxXH2yrRAqc8vJCF2_RLs2-yqR2ubrQd7kkk0wWWXlEIKNAQaUVA4a3U6MmC2Q9CKrFn1pJduUHYqAkyKWUoeyqGQecrH33JwTGyVGTwCATCrjNTMpHtBMfh-nneOX2mWOjFdIthw3Lf8d0cUpaCc2szpI4i47Uebwo3l1_TuCli3OnCwHOJ_sAi069jy9nAcrlhRvestO_Cc_JKBIxaItpj2s2uvCPqWEyb-W-ixa_9w9aLFPV5Pk3YpkyG4Th0QITJhffP5YlwvjGSjzbzrjq2vO3h3dEPdkjZlHWcupS523u9Eec3uqABr4-46ScnoeQWrG8bFnXazdy1idH-KncDEXJBtTjZ__6bKQHTyvIfqtDPp6Budy_EwdL26yflSOJdR43B5uHvjawaLfirwSjS6KY%3D) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of mid century liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to reveal the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

**Sharice Davids has toed the party line on every single issue that matters to working Americans.**

She signed off on the Biden-Harris big spending agenda that drove your cost of living up.

She said nothing when the Biden-Harris team opened our border... leading to millions of illegal border crossings and fentanyl invading our communities.

**Sharice Davids is part of the problem in Washington. Compare that to Dr. Prasanth Reddy. **

—> **Dr. Reddy is a military officer.** When the unthinkable occurred on 9/11, Dr. Reddy joined the Air Force Reserve. He still serves as a Lt. Colonel today.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Serious question – what is with JD Vance?!
First, we heard Vance’s comments about “miserable, childless cat ladies,” and then his belief that people with kids should get more votes than everyone else.
Now, we hear in Vance’s own words about how teachers who do not have biological children “disorient and really disturb” him.
You know what ‘disorients and really disturbs’ me? Vance’s obsession with whether or not women give birth, and his extreme policies that rob us of our choices.
Vance, Trump, and my own MAGA opponent need to be held accountable for these dangerous beliefs and policies – we can’t let them take their extreme agenda to the White House and Congress. Will you chip in to my re-election campaign right now to help make sure I can win big in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Vance makes it clear that he thinks women need to be moms to have value – but only if they’re the ‘right kind’ of moms, of course. He’s even said Kamala Harris isn’t a mom, though she’s known as “momala” to her two step-kids.
I can’t believe this has to be said out loud, but here we are: Step-parents are parents. LGBTQ+ parents are parents. Parents who use fertility treatments and IVF are parents. And sometimes, our parents are simply the people who step up – extended family, grandparents (JD Vance knows this firsthand!), and even teachers.
Vance might not understand what makes a family, but the American people do – and in November, we need to send a message to Republicans that their extreme anti-woman and anti-family agenda doesn’t work for us.
Together, I know we can elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz and flip the House. But Democrats are still the underdogs in this election, so I’m asking for your help. Will you pitch in to my re-election campaign today so we can send a powerful message in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

body:
In a follow-up to his best seller "Letters to Trump," Donald Trump releases a book depicting recent events from the campaign trail.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Exclusive: Donald Trump Releases Latest Book “Save America,” Illinois Review Secures Autographed Advance Release Copy (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
President Donald Trump's latest book, "Save America." (Source: Illinois Review)
By Illinois Review

As a follow-up to his best seller “Letters to Trump,” (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/04/an-evening-at-mar-a-lago-exclusive-president-trump-private-book-launch-party-for-letters-to-trump.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) former President and Republican presidential nominee Donald Trump released today “Save America,” a coffee table book bearing recent images from his campaign trail. Among the 359 pages of images are Trump’s Georgia mugshot, his debate with Joe Biden, the assassination attempt at his rally in Pennsylvania, last month’s RNC convention, his interview with Tesla, SpaceX and X CEO Elon Musk, and the DNC’s selection of Kamala Harris.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
"Save America" opens with an image of the Fulton County Sheriff's mugshot photo of Donald Trump. (Source: Illinois Review)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Illinois Review secured an advance copy of the book, personally autographed by the 45th President.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
A placard on the inside cover of the copy of "Save America" obtained by Illinois Review, in which the 45th President has included his iconic signature. (Source: Illinois Review)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In what may be most impressive about Trump’s latest book is that more than half of the content – hundreds of images – come from the last six weeks, a publication feat unlike any other.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
"Save America" includes images from the recent Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc., in which long-time friend and CEO of Ulimate Fighting Championship, Dana White, left, introduced Donald Trump. American musician and songwriter, Kid Rock, right, performed at the RNC. (Source: Illinois Review)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/exclusive-donald-trump-releases-latest-book-save-america-illinois-review-secures-autographed-advance-release-copy.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
The capstone event featured in the book, and included as the cover photo, is the assassination attempt against President Trump that took place on July 13, 2024, at 6:11 pm local time, at his rally in Butler, Pennsylvania. Recently, multiple Secret Service agents were placed on leave (https://www.foxnews.com/us/multiple-secret-service-agents-put-on-leave-following-trump-assassination-attempt?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) as the investigation into the assassination attempt continues.
https://45books.com/collections/books?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
"Save America" concludes with images from the July 13, 2024 assassination attempt of Donald Trump, including this now-famous image of Trump raising his fist after his ear was struck by a bullet. (Source: Illinois Review)
The densely packed book is published by Winning Team Publishing (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/donald-trump-jr-to-visit-illinois-during-letters-to-trump-book-tour-as-desantis-campaign-supporter-jeanne-ives-sends-emissaries-in-hopes-of-securing-an-interview-share-stage-with-vip-guest.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , a joint venture between the president’s son, Donald Trump, Jr., and Sergio Gor. A year ago, AM 560 Host Jeanne Ives (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/am-560-host-jeanne-ives-has-history-of-slamming-ir-says-conservative-publication-full-of-lies-and-garbage-falsely-alleges-trump-jr-event-cant-sell-ticke.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) slammed Donald Trump, Jr.’s book tour, falsely alleging that the event in Addison, Illinois, could not sell tickets. More than 1,000 people attended the October 28, 2023 sold-out
(https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/10/ir-exclusive-donald-trump-jr-visits-illinois-draws-large-crowds-energizes-inspires-grassroots-base-during-national-book-tour-to-promote-bestselling-book.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) event.

Copies of the book are now available for purchase at 45books.com (https://45books.com/collections/books?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=2aff708e02-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for $99.00. Autographed versions are available for $499.00.

name: John Repke for Montana State Auditor 2024
subject: We need a Montana State Auditor who you can trust.
body:
I need your help to win. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ebd01c7aa7ef/we-need-a-montana-state-auditor-who-you-can-trust-7226373?e=9ec0a0596f)
---
|
#
---
| **You are about to vote for a new Montana State Auditor - a decision that impacts you, your family, and your community more than you may realize.**
Most Montanans are struggling to make ends meet. Food, housing, education, travel, property taxes, utility rates, everything is more expensive than ever. This is true when it comes to the cost of insurance in Montana as well. Prices are skyrocketing and some insurance companies are refusing to offer policies to Montana homeowners.
**That’s where the role of Montana’s State Auditor is vital.**
---
[](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=3d01479fcc&e=9ec0a0596f)
| When I’m your State Auditor my priorities are:

* Lower the price of insurance in Montana, while guaranteeing access to high-quality insurance that is reliable, consistent and doesn’t disappear when you need it - at fair prices.
* Defend the privacy rights of Montanas by keeping the government and insurance companies out of your doctor’s office and out of your bedroom, ensuring that every Montanan -- women especially -- is trusted to make their medical and personal decisions without government intervention.
* Protect Montana seniors and families from fraudsters targeting people vulnerable to scams.
* Promote access to public lands and waterways for hunting, fishing and recreation, as a member of the Montana State Land Board.

[**Join me on this mission. Your donation of $10, $25, or even $50 will go a long way to ensure that Montanas have a State Auditor who is worthy of your trust. My opponent is a lifelong politician approved a 25 percent increase in Northwestern Energy’s rates as a member of the Public Service Commission and runs for a new office every two years.**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=2ff1e8dd1f&e=9ec0a0596f)

---
[ACT NOW](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=5687738530&e=9ec0a0596f)
| [**Why would we trust him again with any position of significance or our insurance rates?**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=77e30c9525&e=9ec0a0596f)
I’m a businessman with decades of experience in corporate finance. I have a record of blowing the whistle on corporate fraud and I have the courage to take on anybody who seeks to harm Montanans and our families.
Montana deserves a State Auditor who is trustworthy and dedicated to the job. I will get the job done right.
Can I count on your vote?

**Best,**
---
[](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=80669d73d5&e=9ec0a0596f)

subject: A longer email, but worth the read
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
The industrial media complex attacks me for this
| [ ](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=871bc250e56045409d1f71e17a2b795c&_e=BGh756FAt349uKpShocp5UKIrIMPHyZLfeMS7cBAG8Ejg6BFN_UlDSWMsmdeG5qYfNAGVPFNqfkTPrxZGFvfbkqv2TN6VN9K-eILXmRfVOpcKC8OyEbPhXL_kbY9lOYjF2pFJTNDyl8WzF5SyQlWnV_cSDRCSOrwqlH3VtfPfYcg41Jguefr1rQU9XXfEVGbiCd6AsXooJr1xew9ZfAzirlwJ0fjQu4xfSrH2Vj-7YEdAFStgeL2Dc-ERGC54IDZKJhrxEuWZ1SsmWwx8OjHfE_s-YpOdW7X-QVMCu4iC801ZF0eoNQrRIg5Yu7xInfCnJcP1KfyrtT_ylRGTN4U9Uz_Eo9qYsWKIezuqF0qnmY%3D)
---

Fellow American,

In 2012, I was drafted into the NBA--it was a dream come true until I decided to stand up for what I believed in. I've struggled with mental health my entire life, and severe anxiety has been a demon following me at every turn in life. Mental health carried more of a stigma back then; it was hard to open up and take a stand, especially as a first-year player in the NBA. _But, that didn 't stop me from risking everything for something I believed in._

**My story is ultimately one of healing, perseverance, and redemption.**

[](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=871bc250e56045409d1f71e17a2b795c&_e=BGh756FAt349uKpShocp5UKIrIMPHyZLfeMS7cBAG8Ejg6BFN_UlDSWMsmdeG5qYfNAGVPFNqfkTPrxZGFvfbkqv2TN6VN9K-eILXmRfVOpcKC8OyEbPhXL_kbY9lOYjF2pFJTNDyl8WzF5SyQlWnV_cSDRCSOrwqlH3VtfPfYcg41Jguefr1rQU9XXfEVGbow0IA3ulP0IHUdtCjpgCJOdmWciCdQQ2DtVSJyBhgehq5hG2FbKoI1GOhrOIKpqheikWIclrnvZicW-2iv-ywyl6spIcmh47OonYudlbIaNwcbwVy7M8U7tGDXXgrhlxNSRj436X4RQcU68srn3C4I-ejx5BlJhtgXCophi3DCs%3D)
At the time, the NBA didn't have any policies to support players' mental health. A grueling 82-game season will weigh on anyone--the best athletes in the world included. As someone who has dealt with an extreme level of anxiety growing up, being thrust onto one of the biggest stages in the world at 21 years old was challenging, to say the least. That's why I decided to speak out and open a dialogue with the NBA about mental health. It was a huge risk at the time, but one that I believed was worth it. I hoped I could help other players who were struggling get the resources they needed.

I did. Despite my speaking out resulting in a huge divide between myself and the NBA, causing me to give up my childhood dream and move over to Canada's professional basketball league, I still think it was worth it. **If I had to, I would do it all again, no questions asked. Now, the NBA has a policy for players ' mental health, and I like to think that I started the conversation to make that happen.**

Throughout the process, my name was dragged through the mud by the Industrial Media Complex. As I said, in 2012, there was a much different stigma about mental health than there is today. But I put my name, my career, and my life on the line to stand up for myself and other players who kept silent because it was bigger than basketball.

**_Today, I have a simple message for anyone struggling with mental health, including our troops, veterans, children, and all Americans: there 's no shame in asking for help, and there's no shame in standing up for yourself. If I could do it, so can you._**

But now that I'm running for Senate, my story is resurfacing, and I'm being attacked by the Radical Left. Fellow
Patriot,

I feel
like our culture has forgotten-or ignored-some very important and
basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our
society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its
most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was
once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has
become the new normal.

Medicine
tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also
tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves,
and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not
treated as though they are alive or even human.

As a
surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you
that they are very much alive.

Life is a
precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No
person is disposable, and every life is precious according to
Him.

I believe
that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this
right by our society. I believe that together we can make a
difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also
believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe
that you believe that too.

I've
started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are
looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that
values life but that takes people like you and I making a
commitment.

The first
step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing
to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me today
and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?

I've
created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you
read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals
and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the
unborn?
