subject: Texas MAGA Fest
body:
Urgent update!

| | | | **FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
We have some exciting news! Due to popular demand and an opportunity to bring you an even better experience, **Texas MAGA Fest: We Are The Trump Card** has been **rescheduled** to **Saturday, September 28, 2024** and will now take place at **Texas Thunder Saloon** in **Waller, TX**.
We can't wait for you to join us for an unforgettable day of patriotism, community, and celebration.

**Here are the details:**
**Date:** Saturday, September 28, 2024
**Time:** **Family-Friendly:** 3 PM - 7 PM **Adults Only:** 7 PM - 11 PM
**Location:** Texas Thunder Saloon 29460 FM 1488 Waller, TX 77484
****
**What's in store for you?**

* **VIP Experience (Limited to 30):** Get an exclusive 10% discount on drinks, a premium cigar, and a one-of-a-kind VIP T-shirt only available to VIP attendees. Act fast—VIP tickets are limited to create demand and exclusivity!

* **Trump Train:** Hop on and join the excitement as we kick off the event with a show of patriotic pride that you won’t want to miss.

* **Veteran Cigar Night:** Relax with a cigar while honoring our nation’s heroes in the adults-only evening portion of the event.

* **Live Music:** Enjoy live performances that will keep the energy high and the celebration going.

* **Open Mic:** Your voice matters! Share your thoughts, grievances, or solutions with the community in our open mic session.

* **Patriotic Car Show:** Deck out your ride in red, white, and blue and compete for prizes in our patriotic car contest.

* **Vendors:** Explore a variety of local vendors offering patriotic gear, unique items, and more.

* **Food & Drinks:** Fuel up with delicious food and refreshing drinks throughout the day!

**Tickets:**
* General Admission: $10
* VIP Admission: $50 (only 30 tickets available!)

**What's included with VIP?**
* 10% off all drinks!
* Free Premium Cigar for Veteran Cigar Night!
* Exclusive VIP T-Shirt not available to General Admission

[Secure Your Tickets Now!](https://jamesonellis.acemlna.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE4UqLMDKF8yQxMUeBt2H6kk_Ugle02XHXLUneg7pN__ky.zeJy142jiNE~jvYxXnnJ)

I made clear on 10/7 that Hamas committed war crimes by targeting and killing civilians. I state this again to preempt the inevitable complaint that I haven't condemned Hamas in the last 15 minutes. On Tuesday September 3, U.S. Attorney General Merrick Garland [charged six Hamas leaders with terrorism for killing and kidnapping American civilians, and for helping fund Hamas](https://substack.com/redirect/c0d149ea-2e16-4247-afc7-65179fc70b93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The DOJ press statement declared in significant part:
> The Justice Department announced today the unsealing of terrorism, murder conspiracy, and sanctions-evasion charges against six senior leaders of Hamas, a designated foreign terrorist organization. The charges relate to the defendants' central roles in the October 7 Hamas Massacres, involving the murders and kidnappings of countless innocent civilians, including American citizens.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/75f280ed-633e-42dc-8dab-b5620133afaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu (Left) and Hamas Leader Yahya Sinwar (Right). Credit: AP
I am glad the Department of Justice is pursuing those who commit acts of violence and terrorism against the United States and its citizens--an obligation upon any sovereign nation. **The question is, when it comes to Palestine and Israel, why is the DOJ stopping with Hamas?** If the DOJ wants to ensure its own legitimacy, and instead actually uphold justice, it must stop the hypocrisy of selective safety and security for the American people, and instead prosecute _all_ war crimes committed against American citizens. It's current failure to do so is indefensible.
**Let 's Address This.**

## Assassinating American journalists
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/47d3768b-661c-430c-a400-21c5b5420b4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
American citizen and Palestinian Christian journalist Shireen Abu Akleh. Credit: Guy Smallman/Getty Images
On May 11, 2022, Israeli soldiers killed prominent journalist, Shireen Abu Akleh. A detailed UN inquiry concluded that the Israeli military killed Shireen Abu Akleh "[without justification](https://substack.com/redirect/070d203a-f26b-48c4-9512-6cb4dc33ee07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):"
> The Commission concludes on reasonable grounds that the Israeli security forces used lethal force without justification under international human rights law and intentionally or recklessly violated the right to life of Shireen Abu Akleh.
Abu Akleh was a U.S. Citizen and also a Palestinian Christian. Yet more than two years after her brutal murder, the Department of Justice has refused to take any action, or even so much as provide an update on holding the Israeli military accountable for assassinating this American citizen in broad daylight. Sarah Leah Whitson is executive director of Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN), a media company founded by the late Jamal Kashoggi--also assassinated by a regime that the United States refuses to hold accountable. Whitson [wrote to AG Garland](https://substack.com/redirect/129836fc-0116-4021-b1b4-6de5fcd5458b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in late July:
> Perhaps the DOJ thinks we will forget about the murder of Shireen Abu Akleh as well as the investigation it promised the American people two years ago, but we have not. The DOJ should take responsibility for its apparent failure to make progress on this investigation, which has fueled Israeli impunity, leading to the systematic and widespread killings of Palestinian journalists, at least 108 since Abu-Akleh's 2022 killing. Without an interim update on the investigation or a concluding report, it is hard to take seriously U.S. claims that it will vigorously investigate and hold accountable extrajudicial killings of American citizens.
Whitson's statement is not hyperbole. Indeed, the case of Jacob Flickinger shows another example of stark hypocrisy on refusing to hold accountable those who kill U.S. citizens when the killer is _not_ Hamas.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xYH3AYuWCGlblvIrDJpFoowHWtDC3xxTW7el83zr2mE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148477597)
## Killing American aid workers
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0a22a9f5-a413-4031-9382-be1fdd52f4de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
American citizen and World Central Kitchen aid worker Jacob Flickinger. Credit: WCK
In April 2024, multiple targeted Israeli strikes killed Jacob Flickinger, a World Central Kitchen aid worker and a U.S. Citizen. Since then, the DOJ has neither filed nor contemplated any charges against the Israeli military for this brazen murder. To be sure, killing aid workers is a war crime. As the United Nations has [made clear on numerous occasions](https://substack.com/redirect/af7fcf48-98f8-418f-9105-cb9919c64ebb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The Statute of the International Criminal Court (ICC) considers intentionally directing attacks against personnel, installations, material, units, or vehicles involved in a humanitarian assistance or peacekeeping mission a war crime, in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations.
Instead, as NPR reports, while U.S. officials are loud in condemning Putin for killing Ukrainians, [they're silent about Netanyahu killing Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/9abd476b-18cb-4d99-8971-a3dd079420c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> After the Kremlin's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Attorney General Merrick Garland and the U.S. Justice Department moved quickly -- and publicly -- to hold Russia to account for possible war crimes. Asked by a Fox News reporter, "where are you on war crimes relating to Hamas?" Garland replied: "Hamas murdered more than 30 Americans and kidnapped more during their terrorist attack on Oct. 7. We are investigating those heinous crimes, and we will hold those people accountable." Garland made no mention of examining Israel's actions in the conflict. **NPR sent the Justice Department questions for this story [on Jacob Flickinger] about its approach to possible war crimes in the Israel-Hamas conflict. The department declined to comment.**
On what grounds can Garland unequivocally condemn Hamas for killing American citizens, yet remain silent on the Israeli military's murder of an American citizen and aid worker?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5994a739-7745-4cb9-acbb-d364629a13c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Likewise, AG Garland charged Hamas not only for killing U.S. citizens, but also for kidnapping U.S. citizens. If kidnapping U.S. citizens warrants terrorism charges, then where are the charges against the Israeli military for kidnapping American brothers Borak Alagha and Hashem Alagha?

## Kidnapping American citizens
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1d413205-21f9-4692-b77f-797dbac8c7bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
American citizens Borak Alagha and his brother Hashem Alagha, detained by Israeli soldiers during an overnight raid. The family has no idea where they're being held. (Credit: Abdullah Elagha)(C) Provided by KDVR-TV Denver
In February of this year, the Israeli military [raided the home of Borak Alagha (18) and Hashem Alagha (20) in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/de24ae7f-0c7c-4b79-b98d-2029f9552609?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), detained them, and sent them to Ashkelon prison. That was the last anyone has heard from either brother, who are both Chicago based U.S. citizens. No charges have been filed. No trial date set. No access to counsel granted. These two American citizens are being illegally detained in a foreign country's prison without any justification, charge, or reason to hold them. This is, by any logical definition, a kidnapping of American citizens.
Yet, since this kidnapping in February, the DOJ has provided no update and no insight on the status of these U.S. citizens. Given the horrifying and well documented fact that the [Israeli military is torturing and raping prisoners](https://substack.com/redirect/720cabd5-8cb3-4484-b807-b4a91cde3241?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with impunity, it is outrageous that AG Garland has remained silent on the Alagha brothers. Would Garland have been so silent if Hamas kidnapped and detained the Alagha brothers?
And finally, quite unfortunately, Garland's silence does not stop here--it extends to selective outrage on funding Hamas.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xYH3AYuWCGlblvIrDJpFoowHWtDC3xxTW7el83zr2mE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148477597)
## Netanyahu's strategy to fund Hamas
The United States government designated Hamas as a terrorist organization in 1997. In his September 3 press conference, AG Garland made explicit that his terrorism charges against Hamas leadership are, in major part due to, "[extensive funding for Hamas' terror wing](https://substack.com/redirect/c0d149ea-2e16-4247-afc7-65179fc70b93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." This is not controversial. Criminal accountability for funding a designated terrorist organization has long been part of American legal jurisprudence. The next logical question is, therefore, when will AG Garland file charges against Netanyahu for helping fund Hamas--as Netanyahu himself has admitted? [The Times of Israel reported](https://substack.com/redirect/927c9b86-c513-494f-a030-0a52a0500d56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in an article published on October 8, 2023:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40e98a6a-1ad4-4b23-b965-65184ffa467e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
> Israel has allowed suitcases holding millions in Qatari cash to enter Gaza through its crossings since 2018, in order to maintain its fragile ceasefire with the Hamas rulers of the Strip. Israeli policy was to treat the Palestinian Authority as a burden and Hamas as an asset. Far-right MK Bezalel Smotrich, now the finance minister in the hardline government and leader of the Religious Zionism party, said so himself in 2015. Netanyahu made a similar point at a Likud faction meeting in early 2019, when he was quoted as saying that those who oppose a Palestinian state should support the transfer of funds to Gaza, because maintaining the separation between the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank and Hamas in Gaza would prevent the establishment of a Palestinian state.
This is not yesterday's news that AG Garland has not had time to process. For at least the last decade, Netanyahu has explicitly and knowingly helped fund Hamas--openly "propping up Hamas" as the Times of Israel reports--to undermine peace. If Garland can charge Hamas leaders with terrorism for 'funding Hamas' terror wing,' why is he silent on Netanyahu's explicit policy to undermine the Palestinian Authority and prop up Hamas with 'suitcases full of cash' for nearly a decade?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xYH3AYuWCGlblvIrDJpFoowHWtDC3xxTW7el83zr2mE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148477597)
## In Conclusion
The above examples are not anecdotes, but part of a disturbing trend. For example, last February [Israeli terrorists killed two American citizens in the West Bank--](https://substack.com/redirect/d038d65d-a2c9-4935-a8a3-6438a10e2209?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)both were young teens, still children. But aside from empty words of condolences offered to their families, the U.S. Government has offered no accountability for those who killed these American children. This hypocritical trend is unjust and unsustainable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c058814-a5a9-47c6-996d-f96ca95ee15d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The precious lives of Shireen Abu Akleh, Jacob Flickinger, and Borak and Hashem Alagha--and many more American civilians killed or kidnapped by the Israeli military and extremists in Israel--are are no less valid than the precious life of Hersh Goldberg-Polin. This grotesque double standard additionally undermines the United States' claims of being a just arbiter in ceasefire negotiations. It is no wonder that recent reports show that even after [Hamas accepted the U.S.-Israel ceasefire and hostage release proposal on July 4, the United States allowed Netanyahu to continue to bomb Palestinian civilians indiscriminately](https://substack.com/redirect/f34cf1d2-743f-45f9-9ab6-95dd5080ac04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Deputy Attorney General Lisa Monaco concluded her remarks at the press conference announcing charges against Hamas leaders by stating: "_We will not rest until all those who kidnapped or murdered Americans are brought to justice_."
Perhaps someone can inform the DOJ that the American families mentioned above, and many more like them, are still waiting for justice.

During the week of the DNC we reported [on the unusual case of a wrongful conviction](https://substack.com/redirect/3bf049b0-e519-4024-94dc-65f80417f550?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in northern Minnesota that the state's attorney general, Keith Ellison, was attempting to make right in the face of intransigence from the local prosecutor and sheriff. What makes it unusual is that the state's governor, Tim Walz, does not have the unilateral ability to pardon the wrongfully convicted man, Brian Pippitt, but he can step in and take the case away from the local prosecutor and give it to AG Ellison. With that one, small bureaucratic move, Walz can give Ellison the chance to set him free.
After reporter Ted Hamm [laid out the details of the case in this](https://substack.com/redirect/3bf049b0-e519-4024-94dc-65f80417f550?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) report for Drop Site News -- [and Jessica Burbank helped bring ](https://substack.com/redirect/286fa944-cc71-4b7a-b72b-61670cce7449?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)attention to it on social media -- a number of organizations focused on criminal justice raised their hand to say they wanted to help right this wrong. They've joined together[ to sponsor a petition urging Walz ](https://substack.com/redirect/481c7946-ecf5-4e26-ac5d-f67317c9f71c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to sign the papers that would empower Ellison to take this case over. They'll present[ this petition](https://substack.com/redirect/481c7946-ecf5-4e26-ac5d-f67317c9f71c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Walz a few days from now, and if we can have thousands, or tens of thousands, or hundreds of thousands of people sign it, there's a good chance that'll be enough to get his attention.
_**[Please take a moment to check out the petition urging Tim Walz to take this simple step.](https://substack.com/redirect/481c7946-ecf5-4e26-ac5d-f67317c9f71c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **_
Separately, [on this week's podcast I interviewed David Sirota about The Lever's incredible new show called Master Plan,](https://substack.com/redirect/e3309ac6-44be-4d60-8f20-354587e89fe5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an investigative history of the legalization of corruption. # **JD Vance is Weird**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uo7xc-et0eui-kyd76rh5/)
---
| | | | folks, Let's face it: JD Vance is weird. Saying that political leaders without biological children "don't really have a direct stake" in the country is outlandish, to say the least. His odd viewpoints alienate a significant portion of the population and raise questions about Vance's grasp on reality. The Democrats' new strategy of labeling Trump and Vance as weird seems to be working brilliantly. We have seen in the media that it frustrates opponents, leading them to amplify it further with their off-balance responses. So far, Trump and Vance have been incapable of finding an effective comeback, leaving them scrambling. Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz, a potential vice-presidential candidate for Harris, called Trump and Vance "just weird" in a recent interview. The Democratic Governors Association amplified this sentiment, spreading it across social media. Walz even referenced Trump's bizarre habit of mentioning the fictional serial killer Hannibal Lecter from "Silence of the Lambs" in his stump speeches, adding to the weirdness factor. Harris's campaign hasn't missed a beat in highlighting Vance's oddities. In a recent news release, they described Vance's out-of-touch ideas, particularly his stance on abortion and his comments about childless leaders. Harris allies, including Sens. Brian Schatz of Hawaii and Chris Murphy of Connecticut, have also chimed in, calling Vance's past comments "super weird." At her first fundraiser as the likely Democratic nominee, Harris herself called out Trump's "wild lies" and Vance's peculiar statements, reiterating that the only box to put them in is "weird." This new narrative has given Democrats a powerful advantage, one they rarely had when President Biden was still in the race. JD Vance's weirdness isn't a new revelation, either. While the majority of the public is learning who Vance is for the first time through these strange headlines, he has a history of making controversial remarks. In a 2021 interview, Vance slammed prominent childless Democrats, including Harris, as "childless cat ladies" with no stake in America. This comment alone is enough to raise eyebrows and question his judgment. Harris's quip in 2018, when preparing for a potential debate with Trump, sums it up perfectly: "Why are you being so weird? What's wrong with you?" Despite their attempts to flip the script, Trump and Vance have struggled. Trump spokesman Steven Cheung's attempts to redirect the weird label back at Harris and her allies have fallen flat. Donald Trump Jr.'s online rants about "soft on crime" politicians and Vance's reposting of videos criticizing Harris only highlight their desperation. In contrast, Democrats have masterfully co-opted Republican attack lines, using the "weird" label to their advantage. The Republicans' previous tactics of sharing clips of Harris's laugh or her stories have backfired, with Democrats now embracing these moments as in-jokes. The "coconut tree" anecdote has even become a symbol of unity among Harris's supporters. [**_JD Vance's weirdness is not just a political talking point—_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uo7xc-et0euj-kyd76rh6/)[** _Vance and MAGA are clearly out of touch with what Americans want, but that does not mean they are backing down this Novemb_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uo7xc-et0euk-kyd76rh7/) [**_er. We need to fight MAG_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uo7xc-et0eul-kyd76rh8/)[** _https://secure.actblue.com/donate/no-dem-left-behind-pac-1?refcode=cm_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uo7xc-et0eum-kyd76rh9/) [**_A in all 50 states and send them home for good in 2024!_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uo7xc-et0eun-kyd76rh0/)
---

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12706621?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

**I consider it an honor to serve as your State Representative!** In office, I have made it my top priority to address the issues most important to you, like combating inflation, protecting our constitutional rights, and strengthening our economy.**And my work isn’t done yet!** I know that we still have a lot of work to do in order to keep our state the Free State of Florida and build a better and brighter future for our community.

As always, thank you for your unwavering support and interest in the good work I’m doing for Florida and House District 24. **Please do not hesitate to[contact me](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=59b749e758&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something I can do for you or our community.** I would be honored to hear from you!
---
| | **Tuesday, August 27 - Stone Creek Republican Club & Meeting with Constituents About Gold Legislation**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| I had the privilege of speaking to the **Stone Creek Republican Club** , which had over 600 members in attendance. It was great to share more about the important legislation we passed during this year’s legislative session. We also had the pleasure of hearing from **Congresswoman Kat Cammack**.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Later that evening, I had the opportunity to speak to a group of constituents on the topic of Gold legislation. Along with 30 other states, Florida is beginning the conversation of whether we bring back a GOLD standard to the states.
---
| | **Wednesday, August 28 - Birthday Celebration with the Oak Run Republican Club**
---
|
---
---
| I was honored to be invited by the**Oak Run Republican Club** to celebrate a resident’s 100th birthday. It was a pleasure to be able to present **Joyce Buck** with a letter from our office and a joint certificate to help her remember this special birthday.
---
|
---
| | **Thursday, August 29 - Souls Harbor Christian Academy Ribbon Cutting & the Rock Program’s Founders Dinner**
---
|
---
---
| I had the honor of joining **Souls Harbor Christian Academy** as an alumnus and State Representative for a ribbon-cutting ceremony for their new elementary school. The school is now able to grow to the next level, and with recent legislation in Florida, it is becoming even more accessible for elementary education. A huge thank you to the visionaries of the school, **Bishop James E. Varnum** , and his wife, **Sister Naomi Varnum** , who started the school over 45 years ago. Also, thank you to the current leadership, **Donald and Brandie Currie** , and **Principle Rita Wicker**.
---
|
---
| That evening, it was great to attend the **Rock Program’s Founders Dinner**. The Rock Program empowers those in middle and high school who are underprivileged by providing essential needs. Learn more here: [Home - The Rock (therockprogram.org)](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=c14333ff97&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | **Second Round of Disaster Preparedness Sales Tax Holiday**
---
|
---
| Although fall is right around the corner, that doesn’t mean Hurricane Season is over. With storms inevitably on the horizon, the time to prepare is now. Please take advantage of this second round of the **Florida Disaster Preparedness Sales Tax Holiday** to stay ready! Find a full list of tax-free items at [FloridaRevenue.com/DisasterPrep](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=be829c60a5&e=d1c1b9864f) and a complete disaster supply checklist at [FloridaDisaster.org/Kit](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=17947c6adb&e=d1c1b9864f).
---
|
---
| | It has been an incredible honor to serve you in the Florida Legislature, and I look forward to the progress we will make for our state in the future.

May God bless you and the Free State of Florida!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---
| | _Copyright © 2024 State Representative Ryan Chamberlin, All rights reserved._
State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

**Our mailing address is:**
1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/profile?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&e=d1c1b9864f&c=30d6817c24) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&t=b&e=d1c1b9864f&c=30d6817c24).

body:
June Update

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/crouchforindiana/ppp2gaxknr-12706616?e=8f9fef7158)
August Update
Friends and Fellow Hoosiers,

Mental Health of America recently released their 2024 State of Mental Health in America report (https://www.mhanational.org/issues/state-mental-health-america?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=eabe234ae2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) . I was excited to see that Indiana's overall ranking is now #24. They noted that Indiana is usually ranked low, but has made strides in recent years, especially when it comes to access to care. Learn more here (https://www.mhanational.org/issues/state-mental-health-america?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=eabe234ae2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Additionally, August is Teen Mental Health Month. Mental Health America of Indiana recently reported (https://www.wishtv.com/news/politics/indiana-youth-mental-health-crisis-unveiled/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=eabe234ae2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that "66.4% of Hoosier youth with major depressive episodes from 2021 to 2022 did not receive essential care." Our children are the future of Indiana! For more resources, please visit Indiana Mental Health Roundtable (https://mentalhealthroundtable.org/resources/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=eabe234ae2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .
Suzanne Crouch
Mental Health Matters Day at the State Fair
August is one of my favorite times of the year because of the Indiana State Fair! This year, the Indiana Mental Health Roundtable hosted our second "Mental Health Matters Day" at the fair to promote the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.

Terre Haute Mental Health Roundtable
I was honored to join community leaders in Vigo County for a mental health conversation this month. During this roundtable, we discussed addressing the mental health crisis facing our youth - specifically in our schools and accessibility. Thank you to all who participated!

LEARN MORE (https://www.wthitv.com/news/indiana-lieutenant-governor-visits-vigo-county-to-focus-on-local-mental-health/article_2e8755c0-5f39-11ef-b8b0-8fa49c4e3a73.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=eabe234ae2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In The News
Chicago Tribune: Lt. Gov. Crouch on need for mental health resources: ‘We’re not done’ (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/08/28/lt-gov-crouch-on-need-for-mental-health-resources-weve-not-done/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=eabe234ae2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/08/28/lt-gov-crouch-on-need-for-mental-health-resources-weve-not-done/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=eabe234ae2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
This month, I hosted more successful roundtables across the state, most recently in Munster. It was an honor to have members of the state legislature join me for these important discussions on the need for more mental health resources.

**Cooper has referred to Winston Churchill as the “chief villain” and the person most responsible for World War II. He also claims the Holocaust was an accident in which Germany made a “humane” choice to not let their people starve to death.**
Carlson is facing immense backlash for platforming Cooper, but this is part of a long-standing pattern.

| | Dear Fellow American, You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story. Even if you haven't read the book, you know the name. It's _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we're working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America 's greatest author.**
---
| | [**That is why I want to offer you a special DVD box set of our fascinating and important online course, "****Mark Twain: **_**Tom Sawyer**_**, **_**Huckleberry Finn**_**, and Selected Short Stories****.** "](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=da4b9a2be06f4063938860052def5c07&_e=X8rLUq2GmMjkK35dEMXJRN3byCz0IJjOuWYyLP39PTRPYJwMfhb749Xci-EZ1IeZA5SmtkbLVCTuoGWMFc6RCuQWhgpcCf1U8cdJdL-lDw-Y_v9BbDL9t7NBXkeAjGoIdiWRSc0yLYN9BxZW3przzgmV8rvA_HudHkkL8CGzCH7fBcxRo0Mo9r5W2QnW1arWZ4krpQ41vKrCm4I0x1vhUrFf2_gujLq9CKbMphuEqjPaANB-_oMg9M-yLPmDe3asFP7Kg55h1QZDWK820epr_r4hRO5ZjxlONOJqWSbQDoDBk7uq6yarzv6r2-qsSoi3wAr4AeL77yQkvr-TJHe1_Ao1E1JW5Aij26dZEFheEUMEnhRz8WGU8aIcST17Ybc_0lgXs10yA6MCaRJOKcP9GA9a9Rbc7vR85wDRN4C7WR86E5hmxJkSUVgjkUe_139v) Twain's realist fiction reveals timeless truths about human nature. And while American life has certainly changed since the 1800s, human nature has not. So these literary works are as relevant and as important as ever. Now, we have created a special DVD version of our course that includes all nine lectures. Hey there -- we're writing to ask you to make an $8 donation today to support Elissa Slotkin’s campaign for Senate in Michigan.
Why $8? Because that’s the cost of a 6-pack of Michigan’s famous Vernors Ginger Ale -- one of the most quintessential Michigan staples known to all residents of our great state. We drink it at barbecues, at the game, and when our kids have a stomach ache.
The truth is that as strange as it sounds, these small dollar donations really do matter. It takes a village to elect a leader like Elissa to the Senate, and it’s so important that we maintain a steady pace of support.
With public polling showing our race in a dead heat, we have to be prepared to match our Republican opponent dollar-for-dollar so we can defend this open seat and protect our slim Democratic Senate majority.
We know that $8 may not sound like a lot on its own. But trust us that we wouldn’t keep asking if it didn’t add up when there are hundreds of people chipping in and showing their support. It’s how we’ve won our past campaigns and it’s how we plan to keep up the momentum to win this race too.
[**If you are able, will you make an $8 contribution to our campaign for Senate today? It’s not as much about how much you give, but how many people are coming together to show their support for Elissa and this campaign.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/1405?c0=ebs-em-sep24.adQpTw&refcode=em240904-2-900&t=2&akid=1868%2E135344%2E6fZUu4)**

clean_body: It’s been an extraordinary honor to work on behalf of the nearly 800,000 people in Washington’s 6th Congressional District. | = Peter, It’s been an extraordinary honor to work on behalf of the nearly 800,000 people in Washington’s 6th Congressional District. It’s been a great privilege to serve our community in Congress these past 12 years. I care about our region and its representation — and I am confident that with Emily Randall as our next Member of Congress, the District will be in great hands! But House Republicans are raising tens of millions of dollars to attack Democrats like Emily. It would be an absolute disaster if we allowed MAGA forces in DC to flip Washington’s 6th District and turn back the clock on our freedoms. = = Emily has been a great State Senator and a terrific partner on issues ranging from health care to improving our ferry system. She has the right mindset to succeed in Congress. She’ll chase impact more than headlines and deliver results, just as she has in Olympia. Like you, I’m concerned about the democracy, country, and planet we’re leaving for our kids. The next Congress will face monumental challenges. We need a thoughtful, hardworking champion like Emily Randall tackling those issues. Please chip in now to continue the legacy of principled, pragmatic leadership in Washington’s 6th District by contributing to Emily’s campaign today: It’s been an honor to serve our community! I am excited to invite you to join me for a virtual phone bank dedicated to supporting Presidential Candidate Kamala Harris and Democrats up and down the ballot. You can make a meaningful impact by reaching out to voters, sharing Kamala Harris's vision, and encouraging participation in this election.
It’s easy to participate. All you need is a phone and a computer, and you can do it from home!
With so much at stake in this election, it’s critical that we step up and take action to elect Kamala Harris as the 47th President of the United States.

* Provide training on how to make calls for anyone who is new to phone banking
* Meet other volunteers and have fun while we take action together!

---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=853f2a4f1c0e4a519f3e5157d45dee6e&_e=GAvePq-Pffaml68WNBPD5y5L-h5hQNbVy-EI320tfBDct82lJOUNnY4qA6o9E7vVmkJb5_zHod9vPwKGXAOFfAJHeDyol-VhSMarAirbCFXjjNL47vBdIgeBOIRwy6DJdaxJFXXcN7jpjkObnUGG8M6qQZuYG1DVxlgfzGkYRcL5_7IhcUeFq_giHX6ZRzE85A4qvOQHVy_7sD6HMkn9xANX62S6TUse0cKxspy0TafpdGidxI5zA9OBEPVpq8s4tWvRgXoss0aHyQ8QQDYjErmTkZw1B0GRqrPcCHMlR-ru0FKDyEWxSKNvJRsWJfU-7WC8l2HkcHfvsQCuDZamI0eSeuRkctl3V4gbgSqClwWPmo1L2uKG-WOajahMA_0X)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=853f2a4f1c0e4a519f3e5157d45dee6e&_e=GAvePq-Pffaml68WNBPD5y5L-h5hQNbVy-EI320tfBDct82lJOUNnY4qA6o9E7vVmkJb5_zHod9vPwKGXAOFfAJHeDyol-VhSMarAirbCFXjjNL47vBdIgeBOIRwy6DJdaxJFXXcN7jpjkObnUGG8M6qQZuYG1DVxlgfzGkYRcL5_7IhcUeFq_giHX6ZRzE85A4qvOQHVy_7sD6HMkn9xANX62S6TUse0cKxspy0TacLn4wVcRSf7Ekm6G9s-xsTkCIvPvPT8KiRksy0b15OkUFukCbq6HrutPSWGLK0yFdJa1eBBjFgfrZtb0jaL6Pz1HfhyZWZNYDjTrsEmNwsfQyeAz_CDQRBXHP9_PSfhEoiLnDQnqkKrVK3xNwIgx90)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

It makes my stomach turn that the Democrats control the Senate and the White House. The **ONLY** thing standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through anything she wants - is Republicans in Congress and a Conservative Supreme Court Majority.

And both are being bombarded with Liberal hit pieces, personal attacks, and downright lies.

_**[That's why I'm teaming up with my good pal, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to help hold the line in the House and make sure we have the support to save our Conservative Supreme Court Majority.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=ff1e17cc341c487083c9ad5740d1d91c&_e=fr_nt1Bj6FqwRDcRxZisXu1GdM5mZDL4lFMU6d-MCgRBaM8cgLXB0iFUidaIDy7-wwKSQqs9vZYvDNq7aI361mEWupgml5ZcoS0E8lGkNrTtx6CcUUppM0blDvmPWYTVzSbEl1nGiRys0O7xdTRQThz5isKC5JKUuFbZN1ZP834OIZaHMZBKSX-rG0FJQZEnV2GvaKjOs--qkgdrCzdHAiRhIx6P4qQ7G4iiehecShdFfVlS9M6w8gu1bt0hjeJNfUwK6LtusBW56n1NEuvo4cxlW_eTp1m_1gJ_wroV_Q6zRQN2FbdHUZ3rWjKCtMBl82FhdJ-GcAZgP0eTdDP0uC1wzhatiJC9hh9PeLjiArlSU05jvlah-NDiofkCM5rpVqSWf93QbZxvfTwOQgA_LXdebhi391iE1Ql8LN6vYlk%3D "That’s why I’m teaming up with my good pal, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to help hold the line in the House and make sure we have the support to save our Conservative Supreme Court Majority.")**_

Peter,
When I was in college, I had to work odd jobs to pay tuition.
I strengthened my right arm while scooping ice cream and exercised my patience while waiting tables. But my favorite job was as a National Park Ranger, giving guided nature and cultural tours — and not just because the uniform had a great hat.
My time as a Park Ranger gave me a deep respect for public service and conservation. I saw firsthand how important our public lands are — not just as sanctuaries for wildlife and precious ecosystems but also as classrooms for the natural world and our cultural heritage.
It’s why I became an environmental lawyer, fighting to address climate change and hold corporate polluters accountable.
It’s why I ran for office, working to secure Arizona’s water supply and make college more affordable.
And it’s why I’m running for Congress now — so I can help bring clean energy jobs to Arizona, lower electricity costs, and build a world where future generations can thrive.
This is one of the most competitive House seats in the country, and my Republican opponent is getting a ton of support from corporate PACs and crypto groups.

name: Debbie
subject: Red Tide Rick has left Florida on the front lines
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
if you care about protecting our slice of paradise, you'll join me in the fight to retire Rick Scott for good
| | |
---
Friend,

This National Wildlife Day, I'm reminded of why I decided to run for Senate in the first place.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92169377/496225747/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1837-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzRkYTFmMjUtZmQ2YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xkGC88Juumvx79j5Vv3RHW6n0pY9il1B1DCa3bVJtGw=)
**In the face of man-made climate change and politicians like Rick Scott who willfully turn a blind eye as their policies destroy the natural beauty that made me fall in love with the Sunshine State in the first place — I had to make saving that beauty a key priority of my work in Congress.**
See, Florida is home to more than 80 distinct ecosystems — and in Congress, I worked tirelessly on the Subcommittee on Water Resources and Environment to bolster the natural resilience of the delicate Everglades, wetlands, and coastlines in my district from careless, profit-driven over-development.
I fought to fortify our world-class beaches and clear blue waters, safeguard the stunning coral reefs extending along the Keys (the only living barrier reef in the continental United States), and conserve the countless precious species that make Florida one of the most biodiverse states in the country.
Thanks to that work, I earned the endorsement of the League of Conservation Voters Action Fund almost as soon as I announced my candidacy for Senate.

| | It can be hard during an election year to tune out the commentary and just get the facts. JD Vance and Donald Trump talk a big game about being pro-family and helping working Americans. Just a few weeks ago after Kamala Harris released her economic agenda, which set forth a pathway to help lift up working families and make the wealthy pay their fair share, JD Vance came out claiming to support an expansion of the child tax credit. Here's the truth: just a few weeks ago, I brought my bipartisan bill to the Senate floor, which would have expanded the overwhelmingly successful and popular child tax credit to help more than 16 million children across the country. **JD Vance was a no-show.** Yep, you read that right. Vance didn't even show up to cast a vote. **For someone who talks a big game about helping kids and families, just like Donald Trump, JD Vance doesn't show up when it counts.** Bottom line: these guys are phonies making more empty promises to American families while working behind the scenes to help their rich friends. Meanwhile, Democrats in Congress alongside Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are laser-focused on helping lift up working families. It's past time to make billionaires pay their fair share so we can start funding things like an expanded child tax credit, universal child care, and paid leave, and set families up for success. **That's the future Democrats are fighting for, and it couldn't be more different than the agenda Republicans have on offer, which amounts to nothing more than a roadmap to help the rich get richer.** There's a lot of hard work in the weeks and months ahead, but I'm fired up and ready to go. name: Geoff Simpson
subject: Congrats to Ayanna Pressley!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Great news, Peter: Justice
Democrats incumbent and Squad member Rep. Ayanna Pressley just won her
primary election in Massachusetts’ 7th District yesterday!

Congratulations to Ayanna on doing what she has always done best: bringing
the people closest to the pain, closer to power. From leading on abortion
rights and racial justice to a ceasefire and arms embargo, MA-07 deserves
her leadership in Congress serving the people every day.

With Ayanna’s victory secured, the 2024 primaries are officially over for
our candidates.

Our movement has suffered immeasurable losses this cycle with the losses
of Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush. But the backlash from monied corporate and
right-wing interests proves not only are we succeeding in our fight for
justice and progress, but our mandate to elect more Justice Democrats and
take big money out of politics is abundantly clear.

The greatest obstacle to Democrats delivering the agenda they have
promised the American people is the influence of corporate super PACs and
lobbies like AIPAC buying our Party's inaction. We must show our voters
that a brighter future is possible if we fight for it.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240904.tadF48&refcode=em20240904-35964&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35964%2E1203867%2EnXK5Wt ]Before I talk more about our plans for the future, can you pitch in a
grassroots contribution of $5 or whatever you can afford to
fuel Justice Democrats’ work ahead?

It is more important than ever to have candidates like Ayanna, Summer,
Ilhan, Rashida, and AOC in Congress. While Donald Trump is a major threat
to democracy, solely focusing on him ignores the systemic issues we face,
like our campaign finance system.

Our progressive bloc in Congress has fundamentally reset the urgency at
the federal level around this and many other issues, like human rights,
Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, housing justice, and so much more.
We must forge ahead in fortifying and building upon our existing
infrastructure as a movement to elect more Squad members to Congress.

Our political system consistently fails to meet the crises that
working-class people, young people, women, and people of color face every
day. The people closest to the pain ARE NOT closest to the power, and that
needs to change. While the Party establishment looks the other way when
corporations and GOP billionaires meddle in our elections, we know the
threat they pose to our democracy and must continue to build the next
generation of diverse, working-class leadership in Congress.

Though our movement lost two of our best in Congress this cycle, it hasn’t
defeated us. Our movement isn’t just in DC, it’s on the streets, in
churches and schoolhouses, in union halls and community centers. We will
keep fighting across the country to create the world we want to live in.

Jamaal and Cori couldn’t be bought, so our opposition had to buy someone
else. Congress will be worse without them and our movement is stronger
because of them. It is up to all of us to honor their fight in Congress
and do the work to ensure we can truly support leaders like them in
Congress now and in the future.

We don’t have all the answers right now — but over the next few months, we
will be reflecting and debriefing alongside partners on our new learnings,
new challenges, and new paths forward to continue expanding our bloc in
Congress.

One thing is clear: our movement must prioritize comprehensive campaign
finance reform as an urgent policy priority, and we must support and
expand the Squad in order to achieve the change our communities deserve.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240904.tadF48&refcode=em20240904-35964&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=35964%2E1203867%2EnXK5Wt ]If you’re with us, consider chipping in a contribution today. We rely
on grassroots support from people like you to take on the
multi-million-dollar war chests of super PACs and lobby groups like AIPAC
who are trying to push our movement backward.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240904.tadF48&refcode=em20240904-35964&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35964%2E1203867%2EnXK5Wt ]Contribute $5

Thanks for all you do to fuel our fight to transform the Democratic Party
and achieve justice and progress for the people.

In solidarity,

Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

Peter,

Guess what Sherrod Brown’s been up to? **Hint:** it’s not fighting for you or the hardworking people of Ohio. _Heck, he hasn't even been in Ohio lately._

[ **_Keep Sherrod in Hollywood!_** ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a4ee5c4cc5ae40c88db3c36b6691121b&_e=V6bVbGLWPxlc3dbb2fwOBgeMA55llamG_3oGySkeFoKMBT23x_97aUFVyhDdADv-r_sUHa_bBgNnsE9yfuQ7KAhu-OOCOLTW0h7rjeUyVYU2joNeztJcRDDvLiAsydDNv5wl_rspZ08KZ_gLhE41f7N4yJD1QfSMOEBJRURmacbOgloAdZ9XsXvZ16FLTvL_Y8fL_elevWPemd5SDXJJox11zM2N8fjFi2N8SnyjQ8o2vxLjJagkkjVPksErBIyNdUWqWRNWpfxaJqfDvujLhNufT3Zuv1cXpMBCjd_yIlmtFiD1BGc3oZtpRO8wbkmhVlDbiVW2WxqSYDcnx0GhQduAbV-6DjXfHD2SWAihE6IBHKVk7eg7sM5KdmjPn5y3x5xroCmqvCp0HbzILi1ZvVPyXX7lAMKMN2TS1h6ZT3Tx2vqoToENEM6VlbFJKqG8)

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Today’s tragedy in Georgia
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
My heart goes out to the Winder community
#

Friends -
This morning, a shooter entered Apalachee High School in Winder, GA. The perpetrator killed two students and two teachers, and at least nine more people have been injured.
Instead of gathering in group discussions on their summer reading or playing a game of kickball in gym class, Apalachee High School students were escorted out of the building by law enforcement. Some prayed together on the school football field, hoping their friends weren’t among those killed or injured by the shooter roaming their school hallways.
Instead of spending the day at work, parents dropped everything and rushed to the school, unsure if they would be reunited with their child.
This is the horrifying reality of back-to-school season in America. This isn't freedom—freedom is knowing your kids can live safe from gun violence.
My heart goes out to those killed and injured today, their families, and the entire Winder community that will feel the impact and trauma of this shooting for years to come.
I am devastated and angered by this tragedy. But I also feel determined because I know it doesn’t have to be this way. In just over 60 days, we have an opportunity to elect a gun safety majority in Congress that can help build on our progress. But we must work together to make this happen. Our leaders can choose to act and pass commonsense gun safety legislation that can prevent shootings like these from happening. This is especially true for Georgia, which does not have universal background checks, extreme risk protection orders, assault weapon restrictions, a large capacity magazine ban, or waiting periods for gun purchases in place.
Our children deserve the freedom to live safe from gun violence. I will not rest until that vision for our country becomes a reality. Please, keep standing with me in this fight.
Sincerely,
Gabby Giffords

**What makes these races unique:**
**A shifting council.** Portland is on the verge of a major transformation with the city council set to more than double in size from five to twelve members next year. This shift will fundamentally change the council's role from managing city bureaus to functioning more like a state or federal legislature — focused on passing critical laws, setting policies, and controlling the city’s budget.
**A lack of strong climate representation.** Here's the kicker — despite Portland’s reputation as a progressive city, the city council has taken a right turn in recent elections and is in desperate need of climate representation. We can change that by electing strong climate candidates!
**Ranked-choice voting.** With ranked-choice voting now in play, voters will rank three candidates per district, and the stakes couldn't be higher for climate action. The decisions made by the councilors elected in November will profoundly shape how Portland tackles the climate crisis and adopts sustainable practices.
**Meet Our Candidates**
* **Nat West (District 2):** Nat is a former union member, former small business owner, and social justice activist, who believes collaboration among residents, community organizations, and the city is the best way to solve problems. As a bicycle commuter and a former Tri-Met bus driver, Nat is a strong proponent of safer streets and public transit. As a city councilor, Nat will focus on reducing transportation emissions, ensuring small businesses thrive in a green economy, and decarbonizing Portland.

* **Michelle DePass (District 2):** Michelle DePass is a dedicated community advocate and a climate change analyst for the City of Portland. She has a strong track record of inclusion, and breaking down barriers to civic participation. As the first Black woman to chair the Portland School Board of Education in its 170-year history, Michelle led the creation of a youth-driven, community-based climate commission to tackle climate challenges within the school district. As a city councilor, she will champion a just transition to a sustainable future for all Portlanders.

* **Tiffany Koyama Lane (District 3):** Tiffany is an award-winning public school teacher, union organizer, and Japanese American activist. At Sunnyside Environmental School, she brings climate issues front and center in her classroom. On the city council, Tiffany will prioritize protecting Portland’s ecosystems, leading the transition off fossil fuels, and ensuring that low-income communities and communities of color fully benefit from the shift to clean energy.

* **Angelita Morillo (District 3):** Angelita Morillo is a policy advocate and legislative strategist with a long history of equitable policy work, including at City Hall. A central theme in her work is ensuring that local governments and decision-makers serve the people. As a Portland City Councilor, she will ensure that climate is woven into all policy areas. Angelita will work to improve public transit to reduce carbon emissions and prioritize equity in the transition to a greener future for Portland.

* **Mitch Green (District 4):** Mitch Green is an Army veteran, community college professor, and energy economist. Mitch is committed to holding the fossil fuel industry accountable for the harm they cause to our communities. On the city council, he’ll take action to make Portland a leader in solving the climate crisis by prioritizing climate resiliency, championing workers’ rights, and driving investments that transition Portland to a green economy.

clean_body: Here’s how you can help them win: | = BIG NEWS! We’re thrilled to endorse five exceptional candidates who are ready to take the fight for climate action to Portland, Oregon’s City Council: Nat West, Michelle DePass, Tiffany Koyama Lane, Angelita Morillo, and Mitch Green. = | = What makes these races unique: A shifting council. Portland is on the verge of a major transformation with the city council set to more than double in size from five to twelve members next year. This shift will fundamentally change the council's role from managing city bureaus to functioning more like a state or federal legislature — focused on passing critical laws, setting policies, and controlling the city’s budget. A lack of strong climate representation. Here's the kicker — despite Portland’s reputation as a progressive city, the city council has taken a right turn in recent elections and is in desperate need of climate representation. We can change that by electing strong climate candidates! Ranked-choice voting. With ranked-choice voting now in play, voters will rank three candidates per district, and the stakes couldn't be higher for climate action. The decisions made by the councilors elected in November will profoundly shape how Portland tackles the climate crisis and adopts sustainable practices. Meet Our Candidates Nat West (District 2): Nat is a former union member, former small business owner, and social justice activist, who believes collaboration among residents, community organizations, and the city is the best way to solve problems. As a bicycle commuter and a former Tri-Met bus driver, Nat is a strong proponent of safer streets and public transit. As a city councilor, Nat will focus on reducing transportation emissions, ensuring small businesses thrive in a green economy, and decarbonizing Portland. Michelle DePass (District 2): Michelle DePass is a dedicated community advocate and a climate change analyst for the City of Portland. She has a strong track record of inclusion, and breaking down barriers to civic participation. As the first Black woman to chair the Portland School Board of Education in its 170-year history, Michelle led the creation of a youth-driven, community-based climate commission to tackle climate challenges within the school district. As a city councilor, she will champion a just transition to a sustainable future for all Portlanders. Tiffany Koyama Lane (District 3): Tiffany is an award-winning public school teacher, union organizer, and Japanese American activist. At Sunnyside Environmental School, she brings climate issues front and center in her classroom. On the city council, Tiffany will prioritize protecting Portland’s ecosystems, leading the transition off fossil fuels, and ensuring that low-income communities and communities of color fully benefit from the shift to clean energy. Angelita Morillo (District 3): Angelita Morillo is a policy advocate and legislative strategist with a long history of equitable policy work, including at City Hall. A central theme in her work is ensuring that local governments and decision-makers serve the people. As a Portland City Councilor, she will ensure that climate is woven into all policy areas. Angelita will work to improve public transit to reduce carbon emissions and prioritize equity in the transition to a greener future for Portland. Mitch Green (District 4): Mitch Green is an Army veteran, community college professor, and energy economist. Mitch is committed to holding the fossil fuel industry accountable for the harm they cause to our communities. On the city council, he’ll take action to make Portland a leader in solving the climate crisis by prioritizing climate resiliency, championing workers’ rights, and driving investments that transition Portland to a green economy. = = = = Thank you for your support, The Jane Fonda Climate PAC | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. body:
It’s not just Michigan that’s threatened by MAGA Republicans, though.
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92173659/496240641/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5M2M4OTA2LTA5NmItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cx8psIMKVExtBvI0k7nbEUX5t6rmRpVMezcrXdAlUFM=&emci=becf9ad6-dc6a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=093c8906-096b-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8431045)
---

Peter, The Michigan Republican party has officially nominated its candidates for the State Supreme Court. One of them is State Representative Andrew Fink — an extreme MAGA supporter who has perpetuated the Big Lie and even attended a “Stop the Steal” rally at the Michigan State Capitol on January 6, 2021. Michiganders deserve better than this for their highest court. The NDRC is supporting Justice Kyra Harris Bolden and Kimberly Ann Thomas — two tested, proven legal professionals who are pro-democracy, pro-voting rights, and pro-freedom. **But it’s not just Michigan where the state’s highest supreme court is being threatened by MAGA Republicans. September 4, 2024
Like many people, my wife and I don't frequent movies as often as in the past. Between Netflix, Amazon Prime and other streaming services, it is just a matter of time until a movie can be watched from the comfort of our home for a fraction of the price and without taking out a home equity loan to buy popcorn.
We planned to do so with _Reagan_ a biography of our 40th President who by force of his personality, ended the Cold War without a shot being fired.
But when vicious liberal reviewers savaged the movie, and the man himself, we felt it was necessary to see the movie as a sign of solidarity. We believe that this great man is the reason we do not live under barbarous Communism. At least not yet.
And these critics were vicious.
[Robert Abale](https://substack.com/redirect/d1b1ce1a-4597-46f5-bd22-c11f706bb88b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the Los Angeles Times states: "But here he's [Reagan portrayer Dennis Quaid] just an imitation puppet, the high-wattage shell masking a hollow portrait tailor-made for religious conservatives with a thin grasp of history and no tolerance for nuance."
[Nick Schager](https://substack.com/redirect/53ea3ef5-c5f2-45d3-bb73-f835c3aedef1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the forever-whining web site, The Daily Beast, wrote: "McNamara's [the director] film is so ungainly and transparent that it plays like embarrassing propaganda" and "the worst movie of the year."
Boston Herald [Sean Burns](https://substack.com/redirect/82c9958c-680d-41e3-b095-ce16d0b97f0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) movie critic rhapsodized: "a children's story for the adult diaper set."
When a constellation of arrogant liberals trashes a movie, you know it must be an outstanding, which _Reagan_ is.
The movie starts out with a retired KGB agent (played competently by Jon Voight) - who had been assigned to assess Reagan - being interviewed by a young frustrated Russian politician who wonders how Russia lost its empire.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/322f5abb-62f1-432e-986c-5bcf732c65b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Dennis Quaid as President Ronald Reagan

This is dramatic license. The character portrayed by Voight never existed, although multiple Russian agents trying to infiltrate the American political system had Reagan on their radar since he crushed a Communist attempted takeover of the Screen Actors' Guild (SAG) while he was its president.
The movie flashes back and forth from Reagan's childhood and teenage years dwelling on his religious mother, his alcoholic father and his teenage years as a lifeguard, where he saved multiple lives. His good looks and natural talent brought him to Hollywood where he acted in sixty-five movies, multiple commercials and became a host for General Electric Theater.
But he never reached the superstar status of Humphrey Bogart, Jimmy Stewart or Carey Grant. Whether this was due a lack of talent or his obsession with Hollywood politics is left for the viewer to decide. But this frustration did destroy his first marriage to fellow actress Jane Wyman.
He then married another actress, Nancy Davis, who if the movie is to be believed, simply adored him and dedicated herself to his wish - which was to become the politician who crushed Communism. In fact, the fictional KGB character portrayed by Voight nicknames him "The Crusader" because of this obsession.
His ascent to California Governor and President is chronicled, including snippets of his debates with Carter and Mondale. And the most poignant scene of the movie is when Tip O'Neill (the Democratic House Speaker at the time) visits Reagan at the hospital after the assassination attempt and they recite the 23rd Psalm together.
But the movie really shines when it portrays his refusal to cave to Gorbachev and discontinue SDI (the Strategic Defense Initiative). Eventually, the Soviet Union collapses while Reagan rides off into the sunset, a victim of Alzheimer's.
If there is one criticism of the movie, it does not portray how much the liberal press despised him. Newsweek columnist Meg Greenfield wondered how anyone could take him seriously. The Press screeched he did not do enough to stop the AIDS crisis, as if Reagan could stop young gays from having hundreds of sexual partners a year. And the Press was apoplectic when he called the Soviet Union "The Evil Empire" believing the best way to handle the Communist malignancy was by groveling appeasement.
But for the time being, we live in peace because this great man stood up to the Communists, greatly decreasing the chance of a nuclear war and freeing millions of Eastern Europeans from this gruesome ideology. Thank you Ronaldus Magnus.

| Peter,

Here in Upper and Northern Michigan, we know what it means to work hard - and I come from a line five generations back in our district of gritty, resilient people like my 92-year-old grandma.

Don't be fooled by the knit cardigan sweater. She is one tough lady.

Granny’s not afraid to use a chainsaw. She got pecked by a rooster and took care of it with her bare hands, saying, "Looks like dinner." And on her 60th birthday, she singlehandedly shingled the roof on the hunting camp cabin.

When I think about her strength and determination, there are promises I want to keep: protecting social security and Medicare from privatization, ensuring the rights her generation fought for–like democracy, women’s right to healthcare, and a strong middle class–are upheld and continue to flourish.

[_**This campaign is fighting for a future that honors the hard work of those who came before us. But I can’t do it without your support. She is one tough lady. Granny’s not afraid to use a chainsaw. She got pecked by a rooster and took care of it with her bare hands, saying, "Looks like dinner." And on her 60th birthday, she singlehandedly shingled the roof on the hunting camp cabin. When I think about her strength and determination, there are promises I want to keep: protecting social security and Medicare from privatization, ensuring the rights her generation fought for–like democracy, women’s right to healthcare, and a strong middle class–are upheld and continue to flourish. = | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = Thank you for being part of this journey with me. body:

That’s just four weeks from now! **I’m really excited about the energy we've seen on the ground since Kamala Harris announced her campaign, but I’m also terrified of what it would mean if we take this election for granted. We need to do everything we possibly can to make sure our message reaches voters _before_ they get their ballots. Peter,

I wanted to reach out today to thank everyone who has supported our campaign, including those of you who attended our annual BBQ Honoring Labor on Sunday. Nothing we do is possible without you.

Whether you contribute money, time, or other resources, your support enables important work. Thanks to your generosity, our team is able to knock on more doors, make more phone calls, and mobilize more Democratic voters across Minnesota.

We have a lot of work ahead of us. Donald Trump and his MAGA Republican allies will do everything they can to turn Minnesota red this November. But I know how powerful this movement is. If we work together and give it our all over the next nine weeks, we can overcome anything.

I want you to know how grateful I am to have the opportunity to fight side-by-side with you. Let’s keep up the momentum.

With gratitude,

Keith Ellison

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. But in the last four elections, Virginians have overwhelmingly voted for Democrats to represent us in the White House — and I believe we’ll do it again this November.
Many wonder why one of the reddest states in the country shifted so heavily toward the Democratic Party...
The answer is simple: Democrats deliver. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, unemployment is at near record lows and the stock market is at near record highs. The uninsured rate is at the lowest it's been in the history of the United States. America is building again. America is manufacturing again.
Democrats deliver.
For years, insurance companies could discriminate against you because you had a pre-existing condition. Democrats fixed that without a single Republican vote.
Pharmaceutical companies used to be able to charge us whatever the heck they wanted, especially to seniors under Medicare. Democrats fixed that. Now, we're negotiating prescription drug prices. We're saving American taxpayers and seniors $7.5 billion a year. We couldn't get one Republican vote for that. I’ll say it again: We couldn't get one single Republican vote for $35-a-month insulin.

America needs leaders who will fix the problem — and Democrats deliver.

Friend, Kirsten is taking on the toughest fights in Washington — and you've had her back every step of the way.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92178869/496257716/-1789327584?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5375-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTg2MTQ0OS0xNjZiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ajnrhUSGQVsGZBdM5FRz96oazeqlXY2I8SwEpAYgLOY=)
➡️ She fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
➡️ She finally secured legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. These reforms will create a fairer system for service members.
➡️ After _14 years_ of advocacy, late nights and whipping votes, her legislation to make gun trafficking a federal crime was finally passed in 2022's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.
➡️ She has spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, she's leading the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**Kirsten's record is about winning real results for the families she swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of this would be possible without your continued, tireless support. Thank you for always standing with her.**
